articleTitle: Firebase Database Usage and Application Technology in Modern Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In our research work, the use of firebase database in applications running on mobile operating systems today, the use of firebase system in mobile applications of large organizations, the connection of the system to the mobile application, the use of optimal ways of using special libraries for firebase database in creating applications, and practical application issues are discussed. The difference of this database from other systems, the security system, performing operations on the data located in the firebase system, ways of using the firebase system to store data in practical projects are shown. The stages of using optimal methods and tools in the development of teaching of subjects on the basis of mobile technologies and training of high-quality personnel in higher education institutions are thoroughly studied. Database concepts will be explored in depth, and firebase database applications will be explored and their relevance to practice. Stages of mobile technology operation, possibilities are analyzed, and their application in various fields is shown with practical examples.

articleTitle: Solving the Problem of Forming a Digital Communication Channel over the Power Supply Network Based on Pulse-Frequency Telegraphy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The use of a household power supply network to transmit digital information simultaneously with the harmonic of the mains supply faces some problems due to the characteristics of the propagation environment, such as nonlinear effects and different line impedances at different frequencies. These features lead to the fact that some adjustments should be made to the applied theoretical calculations when developing appropriate modems to improve the reliability and range of communication. Also, in the general case, the random nature of the network and its variability over time require statistical analysis of signal propagation conditions. The paper presents the result of creating a prototype modem for transmitting information over power supply networks and pays attention to some decisions made based on the results of statistical studies using a designed prototype of such a modem. It was experimentally confirmed that these solutions led to an increase in the reliability and range of communication.

articleTitle: Recognition of Isolated Gestures of the Russian Sign Language Based on the Component Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Russian Sign Language is a language used for communication by people with hearing impairments. Automating sign language translation is an important task in facilitating communication between hearing and deaf people. The paper describes the system of recognition of isolated gestures of the Russian sign language using a component approach. The component approach involves representing a gesture as its components — this paper considers such components as palm configuration, palm orientation and palm position relative to the body. The proposed system first recognizes the individual components of the gesture, based on which the prediction of the gesture sense is made. This makes the system more versatile. We use the MediaPipe framework as a feature extraction tool and LSTM as a classifier. The results show that this approach is very effective on a small set of static gestures. Experiments conducted on a larger set of dynamic gestures indicate that additional features and transformations are required to achieve higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Increasing the Efficiency of Asynchronous Motors by Improving the Quality of the Electric Current
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article presents the results of research on improving the quality of electricity consumed from the network by compensating the reactive power energy in the network and increasing the labor productivity of asynchronous motors. As a result of the experiment, it was found that by connecting the innovative device of automatic compensation of low voltage reactive power directly in parallel to the asynchronous motor, it is possible to improve the quality of electric current and increase the labor productivity of asynchronous motors. In this case, the active power of the electric energy consumed by the 75 kW asynchronous motor was saved by 14.76 kW per hour, and the reactive power was compensated by 7.23 kVar per hour, η<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">FIK</inf>=19,7% from cosφ =0,83 increased by 0,99. It has been shown that by properly compensating the reactive power, it is possible to save 7-35% of the current consumed from the network, depending on the cosφ, and increase the efficiency of the induction motor.

articleTitle: Compact Filters on Dielectric Paper Substrate
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents microwave filters implemented on a paper substrate with a dielectric constant of 2.85. The paper presents three filters with central frequencies of 10.5 GHz, 20 GHz and 60 GHz. The advantages of the quasi-elliptical filter structure due to the presence of full transmission resonances are demonstrated. It is also possible to reduce the weight and dimensions by 5 times due to the bending of the filter. The possibility of synthesis of a narrowband bandpass filter with a bandwidth 1.8 GHz is shown. The presented filters are made with the use of SIW-technology, which is widely known due to the possibility of reducing the mass-size parameters of the product, as well as relatively low cost and ease of manufacture, while maintaining high quality factor and low insertion loss inherent in conventional rectangular waveguides. Calculation formulas are given and the synthesis process of SIW-filters is demonstrated. Experimental studies of the manufactured filter prototypes were carried out and the amplitude-frequency characteristics of computer modes were compared.

articleTitle: Solar Dryer with Recovery Heat Exchanger: Production Test
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A semi-industrial recirculating solar dryer (RSD) with a recuperative heat exchanger (RHE) for drying fruits and vegetables has been developed. A complete modernization of the installation was carried out to obtain an absolutely autonomous solar drying (SD) installation. The SD consists of a drying chamber, a ventilation system, a solar panel for autonomy systems, automatic control panel. The proposed SD uses only solar energy. Under natural conditions in a helio-drying plant, the temperature and humidity conditions in the process of drying fruits were experimental studied, and studies were carried out on the dependences of the kinetics of drying fruits and other vegetables. Regime of temperature-humidity and the kinetics of drying fruits in various modes were studied: with and without recirculation of the drying agent. From the data obtained, it is shown that the period of fruit drying in a SD with a RHE is reduced by two times compared to a conventional SD.

articleTitle: Self-tuning Hyper-parameters for Unsupervised Cross-lingual Tokenization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We explore the possibility of meta-learning for the language-independent unsupervised tokenization problem for English, Russian, and Chinese. We implement the meta-learning approach for automatic determination of hyper-parameters of the unsupervised tokenization model proposed in earlier works, relying on various human-independent fitness functions such as normalized anti-entropy, compression factor and cross-split F1 score, as well as additive and multiplicative composite combinations of the three metrics, testing them against the conventional F1 tokenization score. We find a fairly good correlation between the latter and the additive combination of the former three metrics for English and Russian. In the case of the Chinese, we find a significant correlation between the F1 score and the compression factor. Our results suggest the possibility of robust unsupervised tokenization of low-resource and dead languages and allow us to think about human languages in terms of the evolution of efficient symbolic communication codes with different structural optimization schemes that have evolved in different human cultures.

articleTitle: Motor Current Signature Analysis for Identification Induction Motor Defects
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the application of the method of motor current signature analysis (MCSA) for the most common faults in induction motors: interturn short circuit in the stator winding, shaft eccentricity, disalignment of coupling between the motor shaft and the load, bearing races wear, rolling bearing cage damage, inner ring damage of the rolling bearing, outer ring damage of the rolling bearing, rolling elements damage. Such defects introduce changes in the harmonic composition at pre-calculated frequencies, which are determined by the supply network frequency, rotor speed, and fault coefficients. The method involves the study of the spectral dependence of the motor stator current in the presence of faults compared to a efficient one. Decryption the results of the spectral analysis of the measured current will make it possible to determine the type of fault with a high probability, and with further improvement of the approach, to predict its potential occurrence. An algorithm for determining characteristic frequencies of faults using the MCSA tool is developed. Digital modeling results confirming the approach's effectiveness are presented.

articleTitle: Modeling of Four-Wave Mixing in Optical Multiplexing Networks with Wavelength Division Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents the results of numerical experiments on modeling the propagation of signals with wavelength division multiplexing in G.652 and G.655 optical fibers taking into account both linear and nonlinear effects. The distribution of the components generated through four-wave mixing for different number of channels wavelength division multiplexing system was investigated in MATLAB application program package. It was shown that in the region of the operating frequency range, the distribution of non-degenerate combination frequency components has a peak at the central frequencies of the spectral range, and the combination frequencies of degenerate kind are distributed uniformly over the entire frequency range. At the same time, there are more non-degenerate combination frequencies. The ratio of the number of non-degenerate combination frequencies to the number of degenerate combination frequencies increases with the growth of the number of channels in a wavelength division multiplexing system. The OptiSystem software package developed by Optiwave Systems Inc. was used to investigate the process of four-wave mixing occurrence. In the used computer models, the signal transmitted through the fiber optic transmission system was generated by a random sequence generator in RZ or NRZ code. The simulation result is obtained by spectrum analyzers at the output of the optical fiber. The dependence of Q-factor values on the frequency channel spacing and on the optical fiber length was investigated. It was shown that increasing the frequency channel spacing allows reducing the level of components generated through four-wave mixing. The values of the frequency channel spacing were obtained, at which the Q-factor has values acceptable for modern fiber-optic transmission lines.

articleTitle: Towards Collaborative Coding in RIDE Web IDE
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: RIDE is an integrated development environment (IDE) suited for the Reflex language, specifically designed for creating control algorithms for cyber-physical systems. RIDE is based on Eclipse Theia and a host program running independent instances for each user. However, it does not provide collaborative experience. Eclipse Theia is designed for single-user; therefore, collaborative programming is hampered by security and ease of use issues. This paper outlines a server program architecture to add collaborative abilities to otherwise single-user web applications. The suggested approach is application independent. It is applicable to other single-user applications, making it possible to deploy them in the cloud as web services. The paper provides a detailed analysis of the problem, as well as the tools and frameworks used for implementing this design with RIDE. This implementation makes use of Docker for containerization, Python and Flask for host program, Google Auth for user authentication, and SQLite for the database.

articleTitle: Mode Optimization of a Hybrid Power Supply System Based on Criterion of Minimizing Fuel Consumption in a Diesel Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problems of hybrid power supply using are of great relevance due to the development of infrastructure and industry in remote regions of Siberia and the Far East, as well as tightening of environmental requirements and desire to reduce diesel fuel consumption. Hybrid systems based on renewable and traditional energy sources allow to improve the reliability of power supply consumers, the flexibility of normal and emergency modes control, and reduce CO2 emissions. At the same time, the problem of automatic control of hybrid systems with minimal fossil fuel consumption is relevant, provided that all the technological constraints and power quality requirements are met. The paper analyzes the control criteria, as well as the technological and operational constraints of a hybrid power supply system, which includes diesel power units, a solar power plant, and energy storage. Their mathematical models and the algorithms for controlling the operating conditions of the system based on the specified criteria and constraints are presented. The problem of optimal distribution of active load between different energy sources and the choice of the optimal structure of generating units are also considered.

articleTitle: Medium-Term Forecast of Water Inflow to the Sayano-Shushenskaya Hydroelectric Power Plant Reservoir by Autoregressive Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Hydropower is an important economic sector. It provides for the generation of green power and proves key in power-frequency control in the energy system. Its peculiarity is its strong dependence on hydrological conditions. Therefore, the task of forecasting and planning the operation of hydroelectric power plants in conditions of changing river flow is relevant. Accurate forecasting of the inflow is used to make the most rational regulation of the reservoir, therefore, increases economic efficiency. A study on forecasting the water inflow into the reservoir of the Sayano-Shushenskaya hydroelectric power plant to improve the efficiency of water-power regimes was performed. The machine learning approach was chosen as a method of medium-term inflow forecasting. Such models as linear regression, polynomial regression and the k-nearest neighbor model are compared in the paper. The purpose of study is to determine the depth of retrospective data and the sampling step based on autoregressive machine learning models. The most efficient result on the test sample was obtained for k-nearest neighbor model with a depth of retrospective data of 24 months and sample step of 1 months. The coefficient of determination was 0,749.

articleTitle: Checking the Operability of the Social Media Collection and Predictive Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: As part of the research, a system of collecting and predictive analysis of social media was implemented. The results of predictive analytics can be used in the following cases:• When creating recommendation services for interested users in a particular product/service or for analyzing data with a small number of characteristics for clustering.• When predicting accidents/failures – for example, for early repair of equipment to reduce the risks of downtime in production.• When making the best decisions in a given situation.During the development of the system, data collection modules from VK, YouTube and OK were implemented. In addition, an analysis module has been implemented based on the repeated application of the MeanShift unsupervised learning method with cutting off the number of analyzed resources. Based on the results of the analysis, the user is offered a list of those resources on which information on the entered keywords may appear in the future. Thanks to the developed algorithm of work, resources can be divided into "most suitable", "suitable", "possibly suitable" depending on the clustering step.This work is devoted to checking the operability of the system. Tests are given to evaluate the result of predictive analysis depending on various queries for data collection.

articleTitle: Neurocontroller Training with Using the Neural Network Emulating the Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: While using the "controller modeling scheme", there are restrictions on the settings of the neural network controller. They are related to the fact that the formation of a training sample is carried out by using a reference controller. It means that the neural network controller obtained after training cannot significantly increase the quality indicators of the system's transients. The application of "emulator and neurocontrol scheme" is demonstrated in the paper. This scheme is considered as an addition to the algorithm for the design of neural network controllers with a deterministic method for choosing the architecture and weight coefficients of a neural network, using controller modeling scheme. An example on improving the qualitative characteristics of the transients of the system by additional configuration the neuro-controller for the nonlinear system "inverse pendulum on a movable base" is given. The purpose of the control was designated as stabilization of the inverse pendulum in a vertical position and moving the mobile base to a set value. To achieve these goals, a neural control scheme, which contains two neural networks: a neurocontroller (performs the function of forming a control effect on the plant) and a neuroemulator (performs the function of simulating a model of the plant and is necessary for calculating the backpropagation error skip and adjusting the weighting coefficients of the neurocontroller) is used. As a result, it is possible to obtain an automatic control system capable of controlling the specified plant.

articleTitle: iOk Platform for Automated Object Detection and Analysis in Microscopy Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Counting, measuring, and identifying particles is a crucial aspect of various research endeavors. Typically, images containing particles are manually processed using a software ruler. Automated processing techniques, which rely on conventional image processing methods such as edge detection and segmentation, are not universally applicable and require setting several parameters through trial and error. Additionally, these techniques can only be utilized on high-quality images. Also, the ambiguity of the data set can greatly affect the quality of object identification. The report presents the iOk platform (iok.nsu.ru), which uses artificial intelligence through the ParticlesNN web service and Telegram bots DLgram and No Code ML as well as other means of detecting objects on an image. The platform provides automatic search and analysis of objects in images without pre-processing, regardless of the type and quality of the image. At the output, you can obtain information about object recognition, its area and size, as well as its position in the image. The neural network can be trained on user images, no programming skills are required. All the services are free.

articleTitle: UAVs Electromagnetic Resistance Study under the Powerful Electromagnetic Pulse Influence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we study the on-board equipment noise immunity of an unmanned aerial vehicle under a powerful-pulsed electromagnetic effect. We propose an approach for predicting the unmanned aerial vehicles electromagnetic resistance based on the on-board equipment noise immunity study. The electromagnetic environment in places where on-board equipment is installed and electromagnetic interference in communication lines under a powerful-pulsed electromagnetic effect are analyzed. The work examines the powerful-pulsed electromagnetic effect on an unmanned aerial vehicle, the structure of which is made of composite material. We considered a practical example by predicting electromagnetic situation into the unmanned aerial vehicle fuselage and electromagnetic interference in antenna-feeder paths under powerful-pulsed electromagnetic effect. The electromagnetic interference levels calculated on the load of the antenna-feeder path and the electromagnetic field strength in the unmanned aerial vehicle intra-fuselage space reach quite high values and can lead to on-board equipment malfunction under powerful-pulsed electromagnetic influence. Basic approaches are proposed to ensure the unmanned aerial vehicle electromagnetic stability under a powerful-pulsed electromagnetic effect.

articleTitle: Method for Identifying the Source of Higher Harmonics in the Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The quality of electricity is one of them most important and urgent problems of modern electric networks, the effective solution of which significantly reduces operating costs. Currently, the deterioration of the quality of electricity in power supply systems is due to the technological process of production, transmission, distribution and consumption of electricity, that is, the process of its operation. However, the source of higher harmonics can also be an energy system. Therefore, it is necessary to determine the location of the source of deterioration in the quality of electricity. For this purpose, a simulation model was developed in the MATLAB Simulink package to identify the source of higher harmonics of the current, since this parameter better reflects the deterioration of the quality of the network voltage. Analysis the shape of the dependence of the system current at the highest harmonic on the active resistance of the filter allows us to determine the location of the source of nonlinear distortion. A study of the quality parameters of power supply was conducted, which resulted in recommendations for improving the GOST 32144-2013 standard.

articleTitle: Factor Analysis-Based Model for Rating the National Financial Security
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Rating the national financial security is a pressing concern in economic science and real-world application, as it necessitates a comprehensive assessment of various factors influencing the stability and resilience of the financial system. This paper proposes the utilization of factor analysis to identify the most significant elements influencing a country's financial security level. Twelve macroeconomic indicators are determined to be crucial components of financial security and form the basis of a linear regression model for rating the financial security index. The model is tested and used to create a financial security rating for ten CIS countries. A detailed analysis of the index is conducted using the Republic of Uzbekistan as an example. Positive and negative factors impacting the country's financial system development are identified, enabling the government to prioritize areas for stimulating economic growth and enhancing living standards. The developed model is recommended for periodic monitoring of a country's financial security, enabling comparisons with leading nations. The study results can serve as a foundation for formulating effective measures to reinforce the country's financial security and ensure sustainable development amidst global challenges and uncertainties.

articleTitle: Daily Load Profiles Clustering of Regional Distribution Grid 6-10 kV
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the context of the introduction of renewable energy sources (RES) and electrical energy storage systems (EESS), the task of planning the development of distribution networks up to 35 kV becomes especially relevant. In this regard, it becomes important to analyze and cluster the load profiles of existing substations and its feeders, considering information about the types of loads. In this article, the authors performed clustering of the substations load and outgoing feeders for 244 substations of the regional power system. Based on the results of the analysis, the main clusters were identified and the relationship between the types of consumers and the load schedule of main substations and outgoing feeders was established. Moreover, the load profiles coefficients have been calculated for different clusters and seasons. In conclusion, recommendations are given on using the clustering results to improve approaches to calculating the future load when implementing the technological connection procedure.

articleTitle: Algorithms for Selecting the Most Efficient Method for Solving Classification Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This research paper provides an exhaustive analysis of classification algorithms, a central concern in the field of intellectual data analytics. The paper aims to serve as a comprehensive resource for both academic researchers and industry practitioners by offering insights into the selection of the most appropriate classification algorithm tailored to specific analytical and computational needs. The study categorically divides the algorithms into four primary approaches: Probability-Based Methods, Decision Tree Methodologies, Nearest Neighbors Approaches, and Mathematical Function Techniques. Each category is further dissected to include a variety of algorithms, such as Naive Bayes, 1R, ID3, CART, KNN, and Support Vector Machines, among others, along with their numerous adaptations like selective Naive Bayes, GSVM, and TWSVMs.The paper not only lists these algorithms but also delves into their practical applications. For instance, Bayesian classifiers are commonly used in text classification tasks like spam filtering, while decision tree algorithms like CART and CHAID find frequent applications in healthcare for medical diagnosis. Nearest neighbor algorithms, particularly advanced versions like WKPDS, are effective in high-dimensional tasks such as image recognition. Mathematical function-based techniques like SVM and its adaptations are applied in complex scenarios ranging from financial forecasting to natural language processing.Moreover, the paper addresses the critical issue of model reliability by discussing the limitations of conventional data partitioning into training and test sets. It advocates for the use of the K-Fold Cross-Validation method as a more reliable alternative for assessing model performance. This method is particularly useful in scenarios where the test objects are closely related, or there is a lack of diverse learning instances, which could otherwise lead to significant classification errors and ambiguous outcomes.In summary, this paper offers a detailed overview of the landscape of classification algorithms, emphasizing their strengths, limitations, and areas of application. It also provides methodological recommendations for model testing, thereby serving as an invaluable guide for selecting the most effective classification algorithm based on both accuracy and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Stabilized Platform Control System Design Based on Time-Scale Separation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Currently, stabilized platforms are widely used for placement of precision on-board information and control systems of mobile objects, radar systems and communication complexes and other special equipment. Compensation of the influence of oscillations of the moving base of the platform by stabilizing its angular position in space allows to significantly improve the accuracy and efficiency of this equipment. The paper considers the problem of a control system design to provide a given angular position of a platform that is placed on the deck of a ship. The discussed structure of the platform contains an electric hydraulic drive as an actuating mechanism. By means of moving the hydraulic cylinder rod, the horizontal position of the platform is ensured in the conditions of the moving platform base. The efficiency of solving the problem of stabilizing the angular position of the platform is achieved by increasing the accuracy of regulation in the control system, which usually leads to the need to increase the gain coefficients in the control algorithm. At the same time, the presence of small inertia in the control loop can lead to loss of stability of the control system. The paper proposes a methodology for designing a simplified controller structure for a stabilized platform with an electrohydraulic actuator, which makes it possible to take into account the influence of small inertia of high dynamic order on the stability property of the control system. The novelty of the discussed technique consists in the application of the time-scale separation method to solve the problem of analysis and synthesis of the stabilized platform position control system. The numerical simulation results of the discussed control system are included.

articleTitle: Synthesis and Modeling of a New Topology of Single-Phase Multilevel Voltage Inverters with Amplitude-Pulse-Width Modulation of the Output Voltage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the principle of constructing a new class of single-phase voltage inverters (SVI) of increased power when used to solve the problem of available switching elements limited in unit power – transistors. The basis for solving the problem is the principle of M channel conversion (MChC) of the energy flow. To convert the voltage in the channels, the unipolar PWM algorithm (UPWM) is used. After summing the currents of M channels (with the help of M winding transfilters – TF-M), a multi-level voltage with amplitude pulse-width modulation (APWM) is formed at the output of the M channel inverter (M-SVI), which minimizes the mass of the output filters. It is shown that this direction of the structural-algorithmic synthesis of M-SVI satisfies the modern trends in the development of power converter technology. Under the assumptions made, the results of studies of the properties and performance of this system, obtained on the basis of computer simulation (using Cadence OrCAD Capture), are presented, and on this basis its advantages are formulated.

articleTitle: Quasi-molecules of Sulphur in Silicon
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)

articleTitle: Technologies for Creating Adaptive Testing: Advantage, Algorithm and Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The use of modern information technologies in the training of mature specialists accelerates the process of training specialists. One of the ways to achieve the main goal is to create and improve the computer adaptive testing program as the most perfect instrument for assessing and controlling the level of students' knowledge. The author of the article presents materials on the advantage of using the adaptive testing program, the algorithm and program created for adaptive testing. In normal tests, all tests are given the same score, it is not considered whether the test task is difficult or easy, in coefficient tests, each test has its own weight, i.e. coefficient, the disadvantage of such tests is whether the student can solve this test task or not, knowledge is not considered. Adaptive tests allow you to give tests that match the student's knowledge. The adaptive test program allows for objective assessment of students. Adaptive tests have many didactic advantages over other types of tests in the teaching of special courses in technical universities and in monitoring and evaluating student knowledge.

articleTitle: Clarke-Park Coordinates Transformation in the Quaternion Domain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Modern control techniques of three-phase power systems with electronics converters for domestic and utility applications, such as uninterruptible power supplies, variable speed or position AC drive, four-wire distribution generation system for renewable energy sources, controllers for power conditioning, etc., are employed synchronously rotating reference frame aligned with the reference vector. These control schemes involve coordinates transformation of AC quantities to constant DC quantities and provides a zero steady-state error while using integral action as an input. The transformation is ensured by rotation the plane of 3D space for appropriative angle described by square matrix with 9 elements. In order to reduce computational efforts and the complexity of control architecture, the quaternion algebra is applied to d,q,o transformation that allows to use only four variables and therefore it simplify the control implementation for digitally represented signals. The paper considers Clarke-Park transformation in quaternion domain as well as invariance condition of the scalar part after d,q,o transformation.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Effectiveness of the Least Squares Technique to Improve the Efficiency of the Phase Increment Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Currently, the task of accurately measuring the frequency of the power grid remains relevant. Among the promising methods for measuring frequency, one can highlight a method based on phase increment analysis. This method is relatively simple to implement and allows to measure the frequency of both sinusoidal and polyharmonic signals. The main problem of the method is dealing with errors arising from the presence of noise in the input signal. This paper is devoted to the use of the least squares apparatus to reduce this error. The paper describes possible ways to improve the accuracy of measuring the frequency of the electrical network. The description of the frequency measurement method based on the phase increment analysis is given, as well as the disclosure of the description of the approach to reduce the error based on the least squares method. The main sources of error of the frequency measurement method based on the phase increment analysis are also described. At the same time, it tells about the effectiveness of the least squares method to reduce the effect of the leakage effect of the spectrum and the influence of the number of processed samples of the phase of the sinusoidal signal. As an example of the application of the least squares method to reduce the error of frequency measurement in the work, simulation modeling is performed on Matlab, according to the results of which an appropriate analysis of the measurement error is performed.

articleTitle: Development of a Module for Evaluating the Activity of the Mahalla Chairpersons Based on the Experts' Assessment with the Help of Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper is delved to deeply into the integration of machine learning algorithms for the creation of an evaluative module dedicated to assessing the activities of mahallas, using employment data sourced from these mahallas as a primary metric. In the context of machine learning-based classification challenges, this research highlights the methodical development of a model that incorporates and leverages a trio of key machine learning algorithms: Linear Regression, Polynomial Regression, and Neural Networks. By strategically implementing these algorithms, the intricate problem of autonomously evaluating mahallas has been effectively addressed and solutions have been delineated. To ensure a robust experimental framework, all analytical and computational processes were executed on the KNIME Analytics platform, a renowned tool in the data analytics domain. After rigorous testing, the outcomes derived from each of the aforementioned algorithms were juxtaposed to draw insightful comparisons. The culmination of the study sees an articulate presentation of findings, offering conclusions and potential implications for the broader field of machine learning in community assessment.

articleTitle: Miniaturization of Microwave Devices by Using Three-Dimensional Strip Line Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper offers a concise examination of three-dimensional designs of coupled strip lines and devices based on them. It includes examples of non-directional and trans-directional couplers, impedance transformers, and phase shifters. The 3D strip line structures are implemented on both horizontal and vertical substrates, enabling a strong connection between strips when placed on vertically oriented substrates. The paper discusses the advantages and disadvantages of the discussed devices based on such coupled lines. One significant drawback lies in the large dimensions of substrates when strips are executed as straight segments. To address miniaturization, it is proposed to implement coupled lines on both horizontal and vertical substrates in a meander-like configuration. The paper presents research results concerning the frequency dependencies of transmission coefficients, reflection coefficients, directional couplers, and non-reflective filters based on 3D designs with reduced dimensions while minimally affecting frequency characteristics and preserving their intended functions. This research opens new perspectives in the field of 3D coupled strip lines and their applications, including the reduction of device sizes for more efficient utilization across various technical applications.

articleTitle: Device for Early Pregnancy Diagnostics in Cattle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of studies on auscultation of the noise of blood vessels in cows are presented in the paper. The reason for the appearance of these noise is an increase in the blood supply to the reproductive organs during pregnancy. The design and principle of the device for auscultation is described. The method of computer analysis and interpretation of the results is described. The device is an electronic phonendoscope allows to detect acoustic fluctuations in the low intensity that occur in the animal’s body and record them for subsequent analysis and has accuracy of diagnosis in pregnancy cows with a period of 2 months is 94.4%.It was found that specific gestational age in cows correspond to specific changes in the noise of blood vessels. The most useful for diagnosis are noise peaks in the region of 200 Hz and 2000 Hz. Based on these results, a new way of early pregnancy diagnostics in cattle can be proposed.

Author Keywords: the frequency characteristic of blood noise

articleTitle: The Influence of Electromagnetic Absorber on Crosstalk and Signal Integrity of Coupled Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper investigates the effect of an electromagnetic absorber on the useful signal integrity in a two-conductor coupled transmission line. The absorber in PCB design is intended to reduce emission from PCBs, to reduce their susceptibility to emission, or to improve the performance of filters on distributed-element circuits. We measured the S-parameters of lines coated and uncoated with the absorber using a vector circuit analyzer in the 0-10 GHz frequency range. The results show that absorber coating can increase the far end crosstalk amplitude up to 1.5 times and its duration up to 2 times. The high loss in the absorber reduces the transmission coefficient and increases the jitter of the signal. Thus, the coating reduces the SNR by in 2 times, but it still remains at an acceptable level for properly matched transmission line. In general, absorber coating can significantly affect the useful signal integrity with a speed greater than 1 Gbps.

articleTitle: Utilizing Lexicographic Resources for Sentiment Classification in Uzbek Language
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Nowadays it is seen the active development of text sentiment analysis tools, which help solve a huge range of problems, ranging from emotional tone or polarity to the nature of the analyzed text. Although significant advances have been made in sentiment analysis for languages with abundant computing resources, the problem still remains relevant for resource-poor languages, where Uzbek is one of them. The lack of complete linguistic databases and tools for this language represents a major obstacle for the scientific community.The present study aims to address this limitation by introducing a rule-based approach for sentiment analysis in the Uzbek language. In particular, the methodology uses three key vocabularies: the first includes a comprehensive list of more than 300 affixes used to generate word forms; the second focuses on cataloging exception words that defy standard morphological rules; and the third contains a list of word roots, some of the word roots are already marked with positive or negative sentiment polarity.When combined, morphological analysis with these lexical resources can effectively recognize tonal orientation in Uzbek sentences. This is especially important given the agglutinative nature of language and complex morphological structures that add layers of subtle meaning, influencing the interpretation of sentiments.

articleTitle: Synthesis and Performance Analysis of UKF for Processing Measurements of UWB ToF/AoA LNS with Long Baseline and IMU
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Year by year the question of solving tasks of high-precision indoor navigation, such as collision avoidance and tracking of industrial vehicles, personnel tracking, worker safety and geofencing services, location-based alerts etc. is becoming more and more acute. The most expedient way to solve these problems is the development of integrated systems based on UWB LNS and IMU. This choice is due to their complementary properties. The IMU measures with a high rate and low fluctuation component of error, at the same time they are characterized by non-stationary nature, and UWB LNS measures, in turn, with lower rate, higher fluctuation component of error, and stationary nature. In this paper algorithm of combined processing estimates of the PDR algorithm and measurements from ToF/AoA UWB LNS with a long baseline was synthesized. In conducted simulation experiments proposed algorithm for ToF/AoA UWB LNS with baseline length 4λ showed a gain of more than two times in DRMS of errors of estimates over the same metric for standard baseline (λ/2). In the carried out real experiment DRMS of errors of estimates of the proposed algorithm was 0.13 m.

articleTitle: Assessing GBM-Model Characteristics for Improving GNSS Standard Positioning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Since the official launch of BeiDou and Galileo, there are four operational satellite navigation systems with global coverage, and signals from more than 100 satellites are available to Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) users. Improving key GNSS characteristics is the main goal of every modernization stage, and one of the most important is positioning accuracy. To improve GNSS positioning accuracy a machine-learning model was trained that can predict the residual pseudorange error and consider it at the stage of navigation equations system solution. Although the model showed strong performance, it is also vital to understand how the model works. This work assesses the model parameters in terms of learning curves and the number of iterations of the gradient boosting algorithm. The study showed that by increasing the complexity of the model, its accuracy could be improved. However, it is possible to reduce the sample size with a slight decrease in the accuracy of the model as well as the model training time. Two different methods (Mean Decrease in Impurity and Mean Decreased Accuracy) were used to identify the most important elements of the feature vector. Data consistency and adequacy of the model were also confirmed.

articleTitle: Numerical Study of the Influence of Random Environmental Factors on the Heat Transfer Processes of Aircrafts
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers numerical simulation of heat transfer in the skin of an aircraft moving in flight in order to study the influence of random perturbations on its heat exchange with the external environment. Heat transfer is described by a one-dimensional boundary value problem of the third kind. The Galerkin method is used to approximate the solution of the boundary value problem. To simulate the random perturbations of the external environment, the Wiener integral is inserted into the resulting system of ordinary differential equations, written in the integral form. This transformation of the system is equivalent to adding in the boundary condition the white noise in the generalized sense. The obtained system of stochastic differential equations is numerically solved by the Euler-Maruyama method. To estimate the influence of the random perturbations, in numerical experiments, a boundary value problem with a known exact solution is used. These experiments allow you to determine the influence of random disturbances at various distances from the border.

articleTitle: Development of Specialized Integrated Circuits for Coordinate X-Ray Detectors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: X-ray one-coordinate detectors of photon counting and integrating types based on semiconductor microstrip sensors are developed in the Budker Institute of Nuclear Physics (BINP SB RAS) for the dynamic experiments at the synchrotron radiation facility SKIF. The photon counting detector SciCODE register signal from each photon absorbed in the detector sensitive volume and exceeding the set threshold. In integrating detector DIMEX-Si, the total signal from a large flux of photons that hit the detector in a short frame time is registered. To achieve a spatial resolution of better than 100 µm in a wide range of photon energies and high output data rate a specialized integrated circuits are necessary for signal detection and recording. Based on the results of the development and testing of prototypes of integrated circuits for counting and integrating detectors, full-scale ASICs SciCODE64 for counting and DMXS64A for integrating detectors were developed. Both ASICs contain 64 independent registration channels. SciCODE64 allows to work with a range of recorded energies from 3 to 40 keV at a rate up to 1 MHz. DMXS64A is designed to reach dynamic range of about 1000, maximum photon flux of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> photons per frame (30 keV) and frame rate of 50 MHz.

articleTitle: Single-Bunch Monitor of the Position and Intensity of the SR Beam for Station "Fast Processes" of the Synchrotron Radiation Facility "SKIF"
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The design of a fast monitor of the synchrotron radiation beam position and intensity is described in the paper, which is being created for the station 1-3 "Fast Processes" of the synchrotron radiation facility "SKIF". This monitor will be used for correction of the results of the measurements performed with the specialized detector for experiments with fast processes. Such corrections are necessary because the bunches in the storage ring have different currents and might have different positions and angles during their passage through the wiggler. The monitor will consist of 4 channels, in each channel the signal is formed by current pulses. Each channel will include an integration circuit to convert current into voltage, and an analogue-to-digital converter to digitize the received signal. The digitized signal will be fed into a programmable logic integrated circuit, after which it will be sent to a computer via Ethernet interface. This article describes the operating principles of the device, as well as the results obtained so far.

articleTitle: Photonic Hook Generated by a Cut Anisotropic Liquid Crystal Microcylinder
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Curved beams have attracted attention in areas such as optical manipulation, and the introduction of photonic hook (PH) has made it easier to obtain curved beams. Therefore, modulation of photonic hook is a hot topic for future research. In this paper, the influence of optical anisotropy on the characteristics of photonic hook has been studied. By introducing birefringence and conducting numerical analysis on the photonic hook phenomenon generated by cut microcylinders, significant changes can be made to the propagation characteristics of the photonic hook. We examined the properties of photonic hook, including width, bending angle, and electric field intensity, by utilizing materials that have liquid crystal molecules aligned in a specific direction and employing the finite-difference time-domain method. A comparison was made with the photonic nanojet (PNJ) generated by uncut microcylinders. We have showcased a novel approach to modulate the generation of photonic hook and discussed the influence of extraordinary refractive index and micro column shape on the propagation characteristics and intensity of photonic hook. This research holds significant implications for optical manipulation and breaking the diffraction limit, and this could offer fresh perspectives in the advancement of innovative optical devices.

articleTitle: The Effect of Electromechanical Coupling on the Bennet Doubler Based Vibration Energy Harvester
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The analysis of the single-capacitor Bennet doubler based electrostatic vibration energy harvester (e-VEH) operation is carried out taking into account the variable capacitor moveable electrode dynamics. The variable capacitor with out-of-plane overlap geometry is used for simulations. The electromechanical model of the investigated e-VEH is developed taking into account electromechanical coupling (EMC) between the variable capacitor electrodes. Time dependences of the output voltage and power are obtained. It has been established that the presence of electrostatic force shifting the resonant frequency of the movable electrode vibrations toward higher frequencies can have a significant influence to the e-VEH operation. It has been observed that at frequencies of external vibrations lower than the movable electrode initial resonant frequency, the efficiency of the system with EMC is significantly lower than the efficiency without EMC. However, at frequencies greater than the resonant one, while the voltage without taking into account EMC has a steady value, the voltage taking into account EMC has the character of exponential growth, subsequently passing into a steady state, also due to the influence of EMC.

articleTitle: The Simulation Model of the MIMO Radar Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the development and approbation of the simulation model of the two-dimensional MIMO radar antenna array with the set configuration for radar applications. The algorithm for the replacing a MIMO antenna array with the simulation model considering all the main stages of MIMO processing of the applied signals is developed. Stages include performing of radiation by a transmitting antenna array, the receiving of radiation by a receiving antenna array, orthogonal signals filtering in receiving channels, calculation and setting the phase shifts on array elements. The developed algorithm allows simulating MIMO antenna arrays with unrestricted configurations of their elements and various types of complex envelopes of applied signals: short pulse on the video frequency and signals with linear frequency modulation. The developed simulation model is validated by successful comparison of the radiation patterns performed by simulated MIMO and the classical antenna arrays providing equivalent required directional characteristics. The results of reported study can be used for developing the MIMO radar antenna arrays of various configurations.

articleTitle: Geometric Parameterized Macromodel of Uniaxial Capacitance Accelerometer Based on Modal Superposition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents a piecewise geometric parameterization method and a parametric analysis of uniaxial capacitance accelerometer using a reduced model formulated on the modal superposition method. The extraction of parameters for the macromodel such as modal frequencies, modal masses, modal stiffnesses, strain energy, and capacitances are described. The reduced model consists of the two modes: torsion mode, and transversal mode, three electrodes in the electrostatic domain, and eight master nodes in the geometrical domain located at the edges of the plate. The generation of the discrete macromodels is executed using commercial software. The thickness of the plate has been selected as a design parameter. Linear piecewise interpolation is used for macromodel parameterization which have been done inside VHDL-AMS code. The accelerometer’s dynamic response simulated using of parametrized macromodel considering the mechanical contact phenomena and the nonlinear electrostatic interaction are presented and discussed. The developed approach can be applied for fast system level simulations in view of the variation of the geometric parameters.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Heterogeneous Catalytic Structures on the Surface of Ion-Exchange Membranes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this study, the synthesis of heterogeneous catalytic coatings on the surface of ion-exchange membranes was studied. It has been determined that the application of the entire catalyst volume of the thermal vacuum deposition method leads to thermal degradation of the membrane and continuous dusting of the surface, which leads to the proton conductivity loss. The use of the chemical deposition method results in a highly porous coating, but with low strength and durability. A combined method for obtaining a heterogeneous catalytic coating is proposed. The modes influence of obtaining the first coating layer on its properties is studied. The parameters characterizing the first layer of the coating are determined, as well as the optimal values of these parameters, at which high efficiency of the catalyst is achieved (working check in an electrolytic cell), which is expressed in an increase in the maximum current in the circuit to 5 A at a voltage of 4 V.

articleTitle: The Nesterov Momentum Algorithm for the 5G NR Indoor Scenario Coverage Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The 5G New Radio actively growing and it is one of the most evolving areas. It improves people's lives not only in regular life but in business. It provides: seamless connection to entire world, connection for industry, vehicle devices, wearable for sport and health, medicine, etc. The radio signal attenuation prediction also known as a part of radio coverage planning process take an important part in mobile network deployment. It is especially crucial for high carrier frequencies. The 3GPP (3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> Generation Partnership Project) technical specification 38.901 introduces the 0.5 GHz – 100 GHz usage in 5G network. The problem is to predict radio signal behavior in Urban, Dense Urban areas with high traffic demands. The authors have aimed in Indoor Office scenarios in order to decrease the SINR (Signal to Interference and Noise Ratio) by optimizing the transmission power using Nesterov Momentum algorithm. It is frequently used in machine learning applications. The simulation software is developed, and results show vast coverage (by SINR) improvements.

articleTitle: Feasibility of Spine Segmentation in ML-Based Recognition of Vertebrae in X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Medicine remains one of the data-scarce domains, with typical datasets size not exceeding hundreds of thousands items. Correspondingly, straightforward application of end-to-end Deep Learning (ML) methods for Medical Imaging is often problematic. Carefully constructed pipelines that involve filter-based enhancement of raw images allow better outcome and leave more room for feasible data augmentation. In our paper, we explore and develop Computer Vision approaches for vertebrae recognition on a limited dataset of X-ray images of human spine. In particular, we test several pre-processing filters, of which Adaptive Histogram Equalization demonstrates the highest accuracy of 85.8% in a naïve model using the popular U-Net architecture. Further, we put forward the mechanism for the automated spine area cropping based on brightness cut-off. This additional step in the pipeline allowed improving the accuracy to 89.9%, which is comparable with the accuracy obtained for MRI images of higher quality. We plan to further increase the prediction quality of the model via spine segmentation into about 20 individual vertebrae and 8-fold data augmentation. The ultimate goal is improving the identification of the vertebrae corners, which currently has the relative error of 4.36%. Our intermediate results reported in the current paper might be of interest to ML engineers who pick the steps for X-ray spine images processing pipelines.

articleTitle: VNA Instrumental Phase Error Influence on the Calculation Accuracy of the Dielectric Permittivity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: To determine the dielectric permittivity, there are many methods, one of which is phase. This method is based on the measurement of phase characteristics that can be obtained from s-parameters. In this paper, an analysis of the influence of instrumental error on the accuracy of measuring the effective dielectric permittivity of the measured object was carried out. As a result, an expression was obtained for a quick estimate of the error of the effective dielectric permittivity, which can be used to determine the required line length at a known maximum permissible measurement error at a given frequency. It is determined that it is most optimal to use a microstrip transmission line for the implementation of measuring equipment. The reasons are a small measurement error compared to other types of lines, high manufacturability and low material costs in the implementation of measuring equipment. The experiments conducted using the differential phase method showed that the data fit into the range of errors, which indicates the correctness of the expressions and conclusions obtained in this work.

articleTitle: Evaluation of OpenCV- and Laser Pointer- based Vertical Displacement Sensor for Structure Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The establishment of automatic observation systems for structural health monitoring of buildings and structures requires the installation of expensive geodetic equipment. The lack of low-cost geodetic sensors limits the implementation of continuous monitoring technologies for early prevention of accidents due to structural integrity failures of engineering structures. Most structural integrity monitoring is carried out manually. The disadvantage of episodic manual monitoring is reduced reaction time in the event of an emergency. The paper presents the results of research on a prototype of a low-cost vertical displacement sensor. This sensor can replace manual levelling in observation systems for geodetic monitoring of foundation settlement of buildings and structures. The possibility of developing such automatic sensors using low- cost uncalibrated cameras, laser modules and an open computer vision library is investigated. The sensitivity of the developed prototype to vertical displacements was 0.12 mm/pixel. This is comparable to the value of the maximum acceptable error for repeated levelling of class I.

articleTitle: The Average Value of the Error of Setting the Angular Position of a Distributed Object when Modeling with a Matrix Simulator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method for calculating the average value of the error of setting the angular position of the apparent center of radiation inherent in matrix simulators in the area outside the matrix when simulating radar reflections from objects distributed along the angular coordinate is considered in the paper. The influence of the position of the apparent radiation center, as well as the radiation pattern of the antenna and the matrix base on the error value is analyzed. The necessity of transition to alternative estimated error ratios is substantiated. Step-by-step simplifications of the expression for finding the error under consideration for the case of using a two-point matrix simulator are given. It is shown that the entire error detection area can be divided into smaller areas, each of which should use its own simplified expression. The results can be applied when performing statistical estimates of the accuracy of the matrix simulator outside the matrix area when simulating objects distributed along the angular coordinate.

Author Keywords: the output of the apparent center of radiation
the average value of the angular position setting error

articleTitle: Formation and Properties of ITO Films Produced on Silicon for Applications in Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: ITO films were obtained on n- and p-type silicon substrates by an improved CVD method in a quasi-closed volume at normal atmospheric pressure without the participation of a carrier gas. To elucidate the dependence of the properties of ITO films on the substrate temperature and the ratio x = SnO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, the layers were synthesized in the temperature range 170–500°C by thermal decomposition of vapors of alcohol solutions of indium chloride and tin chloride, taken in various x ratios. The modes were set by controlling the temperatures of the substrate and the evaporator, to which water-alcohol solutions of indium and tin chlorides are supplied, as well as the ratio of the solution components and the solution supply rate. The film growth rate was about 0.5–1.0 μm/h, which is several times higher than in the case of spray pyrolysis under similar conditions. The thicknesses of the ITO films were determined using an MII-4 interference microscope; the results showed that the films obtained under such conditions have a thickness of ~3 μm. The dependence of the specific resistances of ITO films on the substrate temperature has been established, and it has been shown that films obtained at substrate temperatures of 240–260°C have a sufficiently low resistivity acceptable for use in microelectronic devices and solar cells. The X-ray diffraction spectrum of ITO films was identified in comparison with map 00-006-0416 (In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, cubic) from the database (JCPDS). The average value of the lattice constant of the obtained ITO film was 10.1273 Å. This is larger than the lattice parameter of 10.1195 Å of pure In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, which is explained by the presence of Sn, which changes the behavior of oxygen ions.

articleTitle: Information-hierarchical Educational Process Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The implementation of the strategy of socioeconomic development of industry, ensuring the economic security of any country is associated with the need to significantly increase the efficiency of domestic production, the competitiveness of products and services, the potential reserves of which are hidden in the internal environment of manufacturing enterprises, as well as higher educational institutions. One of these potential reserves is the improvement of management systems for the training of highly qualified specialists. At the present stage, a higher educational institution operating in an unstable external environment and the influence of random internal disturbances that cause various economic problems on the lack of qualified specialists, there is an urgent need to sharply increase the efficiency of the educational process in higher educational institutions. Consider a controlled educational process as a complex intellectual complex, consisting of a number of specialties united into structural units of dean's offices, departments, laboratories, an information resource center (scientific and educational literature), as well as information and communication tools (local computer network of the university), learning technologies, monitoring the effectiveness of training. It is proposed to build a management system for educational processes in a higher education institution on the basis of interrelated submodels, into which it is divided into a four-level information-hierarchical system in the process of decomposition of the general model.

articleTitle: Fast Algorithm for Dynamic Range Expansion of Images in Optoelectronic Measurement Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper proposes a new fast method for increasing the dynamic range of brightness of images projected onto an object and registered by an optoelectronic system. The influence of photon noise on the accuracy of brightness values determination is analyzed. An algorithm realizing the increase of the dynamic range of brightness of images registered by the optoelectronic system is proposed. For this purpose, a three-color RGB image is projected onto an object. Each channel contains encoded information about the brightness field in one of the selected modules of the residual class system. An experimental validation of the proposed algorithm is carried out. The dynamic range extension up to 20 binary digits of digital image digitization is achieved. The speed of data processing was increased several times due to combining several test images into one and using a cascade scheme of their processing.

articleTitle: Extremum Seeking Control for Low Order System via Sliding Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of the automatic extremum seeking control for a second-order dynamic SISO plant with incomplete information about its parameters is discussed. The plant model is a serial connection of the dynamic part and the static map with a previously unknown minimum (maximum) value. It is shown that a controller based on the method of sliding modes provides a search for an extremum with a given quality. It is necessary to define the internal variables of the dynamic part and the gradient of the static characteristic for the system to function. A special low-pass filter is used to evaluate the internal variables of the dynamic part. A feature of the system is the processes are different in time scale due to the practical implementation of the controller. The main one is a slow transient process to the extremum point, while the fast process occurs in the internal loop of the system and has the form of self-oscillations. Their parameters can be selected in a certain way. This makes it possible to obtain an estimate of the gradient, similar to the method of synchronous detection without using an additional generator of search oscillations. An analysis of the closed-loop system and recommendations for calculating the parameters of the controller are presented in this paper. The simulation in MatLab illustrates the properties of the extremum seeking controller based on sliding modes.

articleTitle: Multi-Level Approach in Organizing the Energy Supply System in Telecommunication Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: the structure of the model developed in telecommunication networks depends only on the existing substation devices and the power devices of the power supply systems in them. It depends on the mode of operation of the production facilities based on the topology of the electricity supply system. Substations consist of means or switches, breakers, transformers and busbar systems. The transitions that occurred in the electrical system were caused by any sudden changes in the regime. Short circuits in the system and subsequent closing of the document can lead to system shutdown. In the theory of mathematicians of electrical systems, a parameter deviates from the parametric state of adults or models. In this process, static stability calculations are combined with normal steady-state calculations performed by iterative methods. Their approximation can be used to estimate the existence of a stable regime. The possible nature and uncertainty of the initial data required for stability calculations will encourage the development of new methods that take into account the characteristics of the electrical system as the systems become more complex. In this article, a multi-level approach to the organization of the energy supply system in telecommunication networks is presented. Assessment of the functional condition of power supply system facilities of any class and diagram and graph of step-down substations considered.

articleTitle: Architecture of a Validation Block in Silicon for Libraries of Standard Elements Based on a Pipeline-Distribution Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The task of validating digital design kit is fundamental regardless of the level of semiconductor technology. The deep submicron technologies significantly increase its relevance, since errors in the project inherited from the design tools will inevitably lead to significant time and, as a result, financial costs for their identification and elimination. This work is devoted to the development of the architecture of the validation block in silicon libraries of standard digital cells included in the DDK. The paper proposes a technologically independent pipeline-distribution architecture that provides independent access to each cell of the library, which, unlike previously known, allows validation full functionality of the cell. Based on the proposed architecture, library validation blocks have been developed using CMOS 28 nm technology. The proposed architecture made it possible to increase the share of checked library cells from 6% to 97% while reducing the occupied area by 3.89 times compared with the use of ring oscillators.

articleTitle: Preliminary Studies of the Characteristics of the Incision of the Skin in Vivo Using Electromagnetic Radiation with a Frequency of 27.12 Mhz and Its Effect on a Living Object
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A study of the characteristics of the incision of the skin of the head of mice in vivo using electromagnetic radiation with a frequency of 27.12 MHz was carried out. Inbred (having genetic similarity) mice of the C57B1 line were selected as in vivo objects. To conduct research in this area, the authors have developed and manufactured a high-frequency generator with a frequency of 27.12 MHz on a modern element base, the peculiarity of which is that it works stably and reliably for any load (from short circuit to idle). The study was carried out according to: incision velocity, incision depth, the presence of bleeding, the degree of coagulation and carbonization of the incision edges, MRI results, in SPF-vivarium conditions (Specific Pathogen Free — laboratory animals free of pathogens) of the Institute of Cytology and Genetics SB RAS. A comparison of the consequences of damage to the skin of the head of mice caused by surgical intervention and exposure to high-frequency electromagnetic radiation with a power of 100 watts and 50 watts is given. It has been shown that exposure to the skin of the mouse’s head with powerful electromagnetic radiation of 100 watts causes brain edema, which does not occur when exposed to high-frequency electromagnetic radiation with a power equal to or less than 50 watts, as well as during surgical exposure. The edges of the incision performed surgically are loose, coagulated by electromagnetic radiation at 50 W, carbonized at 100 W. Bleeding occurs during a surgical incision, when exposed to high—frequency electromagnetic radiation, it is absent.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Thin Film Structures of Zirconium Oxide by Spray Pyrolysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: With the development of technology, protective coatings in nano and microelectronics are actively developed. Protective coatings based on metal oxides, such as aluminum oxide, titanium oxide, iron oxide, as well as ceramic protective coatings, have been actively developed. Particular attention is paid to zirconium oxide. The article presents a technological installation for obtaining coatings from metal oxides by spray pyrolysis.
