The installation is part of the information-measuring and control system for the synthesis of metal oxide coatings and its technological subsystem. With the help of this installation, coatings samples of zirconium dioxide with an admixture of yttrium, introduced for the purpose of stabilization, were obtained. The study results of the coating structure morphology, the features of the solution influence on the coating structure, as well as the graph model and its analytical description, used to analyze the relationship between the parameters of the technological process, electrophysical and optical parameters of metal oxide coatings, are presented.

articleTitle: Application of a Genetic Algorithm in Planning the Optimal Route of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Used for Large Area Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Military, construction, picture and video mapping, medical, search and rescue, parcel delivery, covert area survey, oil rig and power line monitoring are just a few of the applications for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). UAVs are gaining popularity as a model for agricultural, wireless communications and aerial surveillance, as well as service and delivery. Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) research has attracted a lot of interest in recent decades due to the rapid growth of computer technology, autonomous control technology, and communication technology. In various industries, including aviation, unmanned systems are replacing manned systems. Due to their high success rates in military and civilian missions, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), one of the most popular and successful unmanned systems, are gradually becoming an important part of the industry. air. The biggest problem with drones is finding the best trajectory in difficult conditions. It seeks to tour all control locations as efficiently as possible in order to receive information from sensors set in wide areas. In this paper, we employed a Genetic Algorithm (GA) to discover the best flight path for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in a three-dimensional environment, i.e. space. One of the important elements in the suggested strategy is solving the travelling salesman problem (TSP) to find the optimal path. In the future, we can enhance the complexity of our problem through the addition of new constraints imposed by the dynamic environment in which we operate. The experimental results suggest that GA can be used to optimize UAV path planning.

articleTitle: Construction of an Algorithm and an Automated System for Assessing the Quality of Regulatory Legal Acts
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Ensuring the quality of regulatory documents has always been one of the main tasks solved in state-legal management systems. This article is devoted to the development of an algorithm and an automated system for assessing the quality of regulatory legal acts. The simulation of the automated system was carried out using the SADT methodology, using the functionality of the IDEF0 technology. As an approach to assessing the quality of normative legal acts, the tools of the theory of fuzzy sets, previously developed as a mathematical apparatus capable of solving poorly formalized problems of the humanities, were chosen. The work also used an expert approach when choosing specific fuzzy logic tools (membership function, calculation methods, etc.), as well as when answering questions from special questionnaires that determine the quality of regulatory legal acts. For the first time, during the examination of the quality of legislation, along with the expert assessment of quality, an automated technical examination of the quality of regulatory legal acts was included in the quality assessment algorithm.

Author Keywords: assessment of the quality of RLA

articleTitle: Analytical Software Development for Industrial Processes Management of Oil and Gas Production Using Artificial Intelligence Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Models and algorithms for technological characteristics of oil and gas production estimation and production processes parameters dynamics forecasting have been developed. Based on the obtained algorithms computer model and software have been produced which allows specialists of gas production companies to control interactively the processes of oil and gas production according to the received measurements from sensors and intelligent devices. Thus, the intelligent system for production departments of oil and gas production enterprises supporting was implemented and tested on datasets. Aim of the work resides in creation of mathematical application and software for analysis and forecasting of oil and gas production data. Developed models and software were created for analysis and forecasting of oil and gas production parameters. Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network was chosen as the mathematical model. Software is focused on data analysis and visualization based on selected parameters and resulted parameters forecasting with high accuracy. Developed software through the implemented mathematical models and various learning methods solves the problem of oil production parameters dynamics assessment, which allows to perform the decision-making support for companies in the field of hydrocarbon production.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electromagnetic Processes of the Voltage Control Unit of the Excitation Winding of a Three-stage Starter Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper considers the excitation system of a three-stage synchronous generator for aircraft applications in two modes of operation. The level of voltage generated by the subexciter is higher than required for excitation of the exciter, for regulation it is reasonable to use a system based on series connection of semiconductor rectifier and a step-down converter. A distinctive feature of the presented system is the possibility to use the three-stage synchronous generator not only as a generator of electric energy for the onboard power supply network, but also as an electric starter for gas turbine engines of an aircraft. The article presents the calculation of the starter and generator operating modes of the excitation system. The basic relations for the semiconductor converter circuit are obtained, the analytical expressions are confirmed by simulation modeling in the PSIM software package. The results of mathematical modeling formed the basis for the design of an experimental sample of a power unit in a hybrid integrated design, for a voltage regulation system of a three-stage synchronous generator.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Phase Composition and Structural Parameters of Aluminum Nitride Thin Films Obtained by Magnetron Sputtering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents the results of an X-ray diffraction study of the phase composition and structural parameters of thin films of aluminum nitride obtained by magnetron sputtering. With this method, due to the non-equilibrium conditions of film formation, the predominant direction of film growth, its texture and morphology is determined both by the atomic structure of the surface on which growth occurs and by the technological modes of the sputtering process. The effect of magnetron discharge power, substrate temperature, pressure and gas flow ratio on the structural and phase composition of aluminum nitride thin films was determined. With an increase in the discharge power from 400 to 900W, the size of the crystallites increases, an increase in power above 900W leads to a deterioration in the texture of the resulting films. With an increase in the substrate temperature by 10%, the grain size increases by more than 2 times, their crystallinity improves. With an increase in the concentration of N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> in its gas mixture with argon, the grain sizes increase. As the microdeformation of the lattice increases, the size of the crystallites decreases. The results of measurements of the predominant orientation of grains and images of the surface and texture of films with a scanning electron microscope allow us to conclude that the AlN film has a columnar structure, the crystallites mainly have a hexagonal axis perpendicular to the substrate.

articleTitle: Analysis of Parallel Computing Methods and Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Parallel computing is the process of executing multiple sets of instructions simultaneously. This reduces the total time to compute. Parallelism can be achieved by using parallel computers, which are computers with a large number of processors. Parallel computers require an operating system that supports parallel algorithms, programming languages, compilers, and multiprocessing. The system "Online judge" (algo.ubtuit.uz) developed by professors and students of the Urgench branch of the Tashkent University of Information Technologies named after Muhammad al-Khwarizmi and currently being tested is highly effective in teaching programming. The solutions of the problems given in the system are compared with parallel computing in cores and non-parallel computing.The "Online judge" system allows to increase the experience of algorithmic, programming and logical thinking, and the online availability of the system leads to the increase of independent work skills of its users. In addition, it allows programmers to find correct, perfect solutions to problems and work without stopping. In the "Online judge" system, parallel testing of the solutions of several issues has been established. In this way, the process of testing computing machines according to their capabilities is performed faster than with ordinary methods.

articleTitle: Herzberger Method Modification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The quality of lens lenses operating in a wide spectral range is determined by the degree of correction of chromatic aberrations. Modern superchromatic lenses are corrected for chromatic aberration of position at 4 wavelengths. A method of selecting a triplet of glasses for a superapochromat was proposed by Dr. Herzberger. This method allows one to select a triple of glasses and crystals for which it is possible to solve a system of 3 equations with 3 unknowns, as for a conventional apochromat corrected on 3 colors. In this case, correction at the 4th wavelength is provided automatically. In this article there is presented an improvement of the method for selecting a triplet of superapochromat glasses early proposed by Dr. Herzberger. The essence of the improvement is the three-dimensional expansion of the two-dimensional diagram of partial dispersions of the Herberger glass catalog and the automatic search for glasses lying on the line connecting the selected pair of glasses with a given accuracy. Using the refractive index as a third coordinate allows one to determine the visual choice of an initial pair of glasses with a sufficient difference in refractive index which does not entail excessively steep radii of curvature and significant higher-order aberrations. Implicitly, adding a third coordinate to the selection conditions entails correcting the chromatic aberration of position at five wavelengths.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of the Process Scattering Ions from Atomic Chain of the Al2O3(001)<110> Surface
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The first results of studying the trajectory of scattered particles from the Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>(001)< 110> surface using the weak collision approximation (BCA) method are presented in this paper. It is shown that the method BCA is changeable at small angles of incidence and at low energies. There are given information about calculation of the ion trajectory in open parallel half-channels formed on the faces (110) and (100) of a cubic face-centered single crystal. In order to consider all possible ion trajectories associated with the initial aiming points, we select an elementary square area on the face (100) with sides parallel to the axis (110) and perpendicular to it. For study trajectory scattered ions was chosen some aiming points on the atomic row of the surface. With an increase in the aiming point, deviations of the trajectory from the initial position are observed. Theoretically, it is possible to calculate the value of the aiming point, which is observed by the scattering of particles from the atomic row of the surface. We also calculated the coefficient of collision of scattered ions from the atomic row of the surface Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>(001)<110>.

articleTitle: Solar Powered Nd3+-Doped Silica Fiber Lasers Of Various Sizes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We studied solar pumped fiber lasers with primary concentrator. A model of solar side-pumped Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> doped silica fiber lasers was developed using photon tracing method. The power distribution, possible losses and the pumping efficiency are estimated using the model. We analyzed the estimated parameters and drew conclution hich have many suggests for improving design of solar pumped fiber lasers. The absorption efficiency of a fiber solar laser with a primary concentrator or sun tracker was calculated to be 0.06% for a 1300 m fiber. The output power of the fiber laser is 171 mW, and the conversion efficiency from sunlight to laser light is calculated to be 0.02%. The developed model allows estimating of the overall efficiency, output power and absorption distribution of Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> fiber lasers with focusing optics, enabling various investigative comparisons. A model was developed for six different types of fibers. The highest 61.39 W photons were absorbed in the fourth fiber and the absorption efficiency was equal to 6.03 %.

articleTitle: Study of the GNSS Signal Satellite-Specific Bias Stability Using Pseudorange Observations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: There are many studies devoted to the problem of determining the delays of GNSS signals when emitted by the antenna of a navigation satellites and when received by the antenna of the receiver. Researchers' special attention is focused on developing algorithms for determining signal delays (code biases) of the Russian GLONASS satellites. The developed method for determining the values of such biases showed the fundamental possibility of its application. This study analyzed estimates of GLONASS satellite-specific bias over a long period - from September 2018 to June 2023. Pseudorange observations in the L1, L2 bands, high-precision orbits and clocks products and daily reports on the composition of the orbital constellation were used as initial data. Signal biases were estimated for GLONASS, GPS, and Galileo satellites operating during the observation period. The results showed cases of changes in satellite delay values, and the features of some satellites from the GLONASS orbital constellation were identified.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Airborne Electrical Prospecting Technologies Using Helicopter Platforms and UAVs when Searching for Kimberlite Pipes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A comparative analysis of airborne electromagnetic sounding technologies implemented in various versions is presented when solving problems of searching for kimberlite pipes. Three technologies are considered. In the first technology, the induction source and receiver are towed using a helicopter platform. In the second technology, the source is a grounded electrical line, and the receiver is towed by an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). In the third technology, the receiver is also moved by a UAV, and the source is a large induction loop located on the Earth surface. The analysis is carried out using 3D finite element modeling and a geoelectric model of the tube constructed from airborne electromagnetic survey data. It is shown that when searching for kimberlite pipes, which are local vertical bodies with a small plan size, the technology using a helicopter platform has the greatest resolution. Various modifications of UAV-TEM technologies, at a minimum, require an increase in the level of the measured signal. In this case, a technology using a large induction loop as a source seems to be more preferable, but experimental work is required to assess the level of "parasitic" currents.

articleTitle: Analytical Models for Calculating the Time Response of Two-Conductor Asymmetric Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The analysis of signal propagation in the time domain in two-conductor transmission lines (TLs) using an analytical approach is presented in the paper. New analytical models describing TEM-wave propagation in the time domain are developed. Transmission line analysis (modal analysis) was used to create the analytical models. The model is characterized by taking into account the asymmetry of the line cross-section and over-reflections from loads at both ends of the line. For the first time, an analytical condition allowing to equalize the amplitudes of the first two pulses at the output of a two-conductor asymmetric TL is presented. It is verified on an asymmetric line with broad-side coupling.It is obtained that the equalization of the pulse amplitudes leads to minimization of the maximum amplitude at the output of the transmission line. This is useful in the design of filters that operate on the principle of modal decomposition of the interference pulse.

articleTitle: Super-resolving Seismic Locating Algorithm for Reflected Waves Hodographs Approximation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The authors develop original seismic locating technology in a number of their papers. The present paper shows that application of super-resolving radio-locating methods ideas in the proposed technology allows solving actual problems of seismic images construction in a new way. In particular, it is possible to solve the problem of high resolution and accuracy approximation for the phase hodographs series of the waves reflected from seismic section boundaries. The developed super-resolving seismic locating algorithm ensures fulfillment of the requirements in every narrow space-time band, revealed by the considered technology on the seismogram as the hodograph location. The series of the reflected waves phase hodographs, built using the areas of the seismogram, characterizes the family of the investigated medium layers for the fixed location of a seismic vibrations source. Application of the proposed algorithm ensures, with a prescribed accuracy, building sets of the reflected waves phase hodographs, separating close or interfering wavefronts. The locating relief obtained by application of the algorithm allows finding and tracing even not observed visually systematic vibrations on the seismogram. Thus, the approximation accuracy and resolution degree of the various waves phase hodographs series can be increased. It is shown that the result can be achieved using a concrete seismogram or the improved seismogram obtained fromthe set of seismograms of observation profile.

Author Keywords: seismic images construction,wave phase hodograph series

articleTitle: Thermal Modelling of Monolithic Half-bridge IC with Integrated Gate Drivers and Power e-HEMT Based on GaN-on-SOI Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of thermal simulation of a monolithic half-bridge GaN power IC with integrated gate drivers and e-mode HEMT, developed on IMEC GaN-on-SOI platform are presented in the paper. Based on the assessment results of average power dissipated in the functional blocks of a GaN half-bridge power IC operating as part of a buck synchronous DC-DC converter, it had been established that the main heat sources in the IC were the half-bridge GaN HEMTs. The heat from the half-bridge GaN HEMTs propagates in the die and leads to heating of the logic block and gate drivers. Heating of half-bridge GaN HEMTs leads to increased channel resistance and IC output current drop. Heating of the gate drivers reduces driving current, as a result, increases the switching time of the half-bridge GaN HEMTs. Heating of the logic block increases the rise and fall times of the generated control signals, which worsens the dynamic characteristics of the IC.

articleTitle: Gender Specificity in Exergaming for Therapy and Rehabilitation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: As IT products' developers seek to enhance the level of user experience, more attention is given to consideration the personal characteristics and preferences of the target audience. For exergaming software that is increasingly employed for medical therapy and rehabilitation, motivation and satisfaction of its users is of particular importance, due to the need to ensure its regular usage. The novelty of the VR/AR environment is seen as a positive factor for the above, but the potentially negative reactions to the VR immersion do not gain enough research attention. In our paper, we explore gender differences in users' experience with VR-based exergaming (VRE). We describe the experimental study that we performed with 54 subjects who engaged with Beat Saber game in VR, tasked with crashing various flying blocks with two light sabers. The game score reflected the objective exergaming performance, while we also registered the subjects' self-assessment emotional state data during the VRE experience and their personal characteristics. Our results suggest that the gender-related differences were rather minor: for men, frustration affected the coordination of sensory and motor activities; while for women frustration, personal anxiety and rigidity were related to the decrease in anxiety caused by exergaming. We believe that our findings could be of usage to VR/AR content designers seeking to cater more personalized products target audience and may help to improve VR programs of neurorehabilitation due to mental disorders or cardiovascular diseases.

articleTitle: Real-Time Russian Sign Language Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper describes our concept for recognizing human hand gestures, including sign language of the deaf, using Russian sign language as an example. The key problems that hinder the creation of a gesture recognition system are highlighted, namely: the difficulty of collecting a sufficient amount of data for training classical neural networks, the variability of movements between gestures in continuous signed speech, as well as the limited resources, both computing and hardware, for widespread use of the system. An architecture is proposed that partially solves the identified problems by gamifying data collection through the community of deaf people and optimizing performance by changing the number of significant parameters and distributing the computational load between system elements. We propose a recognition system structure consisting of a detector of the position and configuration of a person's hands, body and face using MediaPipe and step-by-step gesture classification based on data received from the detector. Step-by-step classification is used to increase accuracy with a low amount of training data and simplify the subsequent development of the system due to less retraining of models. The choice of architecture for the sign language recognition system is based on our experience testing previous prototypes. The results presented in this paper demonstrate the potential of the system being developed, but our prototypes are not the final product.

articleTitle: A New Revolution in Logic Silicon IC Technology: GAA FETs are Replacing FinFETs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper examines the main path of development of CMOS technology for silicon microprocessors and logic ICs for the global semiconductor industry in the twenties of the 21st century. It is substantiated that FinFET technologies have now practically lost the possibility of further scaling in accordance with Moore's law. They are replaced by transistors manufactured according to the stacked design nanosheet stacked nanosheet GAAFET. The historical development of transistor design and its limitations are considered. Technological issues of creating such three-dimensional structures are discussed. It is noted that this shift in design signifies a second technological revolution in 21-stcentury microelectronics, demanding substantial efforts from leading chip manufacturers. The importance of a new innovation in transistor architecture is noted, which is associated with power buses – BS PDN. Notably, the "Big Three": TSMC, Samsung, and Intel, all express strong confidence in this transformative technology, incorporating it into their imminent roadmaps alongside the innovative BS PDN approach.

articleTitle: Quasi-Chaotic Microwave Oscillations: Formation, Application to Test Vector Network Analyzers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The design of quasi-chaotic oscillation formation modules based on strip transmission lines with partial dielectric lithium niobate crystals is described. The problem of considering the peculiarities of measuring the parameters of quasi-chaotic signal formation modules and testing vector network analyzers using them in measuring frequency and dynamic characteristics is stated and solved. Proposition to use the comparison of experimental results of measurements of the quasi-chaotic signal formation module on the certified vector network analyzer (VNA 1) and on the tested virtual device (VNA 2) to estimate the insertion errors was made. Experimental frequency characteristics of the scattering parameters in the frequency range from 0.03 to 20 GHz are presented. The effect of formation of multiple resonances distorting the transmission coefficient and reflection coefficient is demonstrated. It is being proposed to apply the shaping modules for broadband dynamic calibration of panoramic network analyzers. The calibration quality is assessed by calculating the difference between the obtained modules of transmission coefficients during measurements on metrological devices and tested serial devices. Modeling of insertion distortions of five types has been carried out: systematic additive independent of frequency; linear dependence; nonlinear distortions of the second order; nonlinear distortions of the third order; polynomial dependence of distortions. After determining the distortions introduced into the frequency dependence of the transmission coefficient, the VNA 2 is calibrated.

articleTitle: Measurement and Analysis of Electrical Conductivity of Transformer Oil Based Nanofluid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, an attempt to evaluate the electrical conductivity of nanofluids based on transformer oil was made. For this purpose, several samples of nanofluids with different concentrations of dielectric silicon dioxide nanoparticles and conductive zinc nanoparticles were prepared. The dielectric permittivity and electrical conductivity were experimentally measured for the prepared nanofluids. After receiving the results of the experiment, a theoretical calculation was made using the well-known Nielsen expression for further analysis. The results of the calculation and the experiment were compared. The calculated and experimental values of the dielectric permittivity did not contradict each other. However, the discrepancy between the experimental values and calculated values of electrical conductivity was noted. An explanation was offered for the discrepancy between the calculated and experimental values. The main reason for the decrease in electrical conductivity in the experiment is presumably considered to be the adsorption of ions in the dielectric by particles.

articleTitle: MMIC GaAs Power Limiter on 30 GHz with a Small Flat Leakage Power
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of a study of the use of a planar-doped barrier diode as an active element in an MMIC power limiter are presented in the paper. The experimental results show that a planar-doped barrier diode has a capacitance that is two times lower than a Schottky diode while the burnout current density is equal. The experimental electrical characteristics are compared with a mass-produced MMIC power limiter based on a quasi-vertical Schottky diode manufactured according to the same topology. Measurements of S-parameters were carried out at the probe station. The power limiters low-signal properties are extremely similar to one another. Insertion loss is less than 1 dB in the frequency range up to 30 GHz. At an input power - 15 dBm input IP3 is 21- 36 dBm and 20-27 dBm, for power limiters on Schottky diodes and planar-doped barrier diodes respectively. Measurements of dynamic characteristics in the high-power CW mode were carried out on chips mounted on a heat sink. The burnout level at CW input power for the limiter was 4.3 W and 6.5 W, and the flat leakage power before the catastrophic failure was 32 mW and 13 mW on the Schottky diodes and planar-doped barrier diodes, respectively. The power limiter on planar-doped barrier diodes has an advantage based on a set of characteristics: the flat leakage power and the maximum handling power, even with the same values of small-signal parameters. The use of GaAs planar-doped barrier diodes in power limiters is a promising solution in millimeter-wave applications.

articleTitle: Development of Logical Methods for Extracting Emotional Assessments from Natural Language Texts
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of extracting emotional assessments from natural language texts. The article analyzes existing methods of sentiment analysis and explores modern methods of natural language processing to determine the sentiment of Uzbek texts. Existing approaches to the study and description of emotions are explored. Particular attention is paid to emotional assessments of situations presented in natural language texts. Logical-semantic methods and technologies based on deep machine learning methods are considered. Formalization of emotional assessments contained in natural language texts is carried out using the theory of partial models. The task of classification is to assign a class to objects based on their characteristics. In the case of the emotion model, the emotion texts are object-class pairs. Since the number of emotions is not binary, the classification is not binary. To solve the classification problem, a training data set consisting of labeled text with emotions is required.

articleTitle: Shift and Broadening of Absorption and Dispersion Resonance by Saturation Parameter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Within the framework of the classical model, which describes electrons as damped harmonic oscillators in an external electromagnetic field, expressions for the absorption and dispersion coefficients in the second order of smallness in the saturation parameter are found for a uniformly broadened line at a low concentration of oscillators, when the amplitude of the field produced by neighboring electrons is significantly less amplitude of the external field. It is shown that with increasing saturation parameter, the shape of the dispersion resonance becomes asymmetric, that at small saturation parameter leads to its linear shift to the "red" region. At the same time, as the saturation parameter increases, the dispersion resonance broadens (increases the interval between the maximum and minimum of the dispersion curve) and, in addition, there is a relative increase in the low-frequency amplitude compared to the high-frequency one. As for the shape of the absorption line, just as for the dispersion resonance, as saturation parameter increases, an asymmetry of the line shape appears which is accompanied by a shift to the "red" region. Because the low-frequency wing of the absorption line shifts toward the resonance center faster than the high-frequency wing moves away from the center, a narrowing of the resonance from the saturation parameter is observed. The dependence of this narrowing is nonlinear. In this case, the maximum of the absorption resonance linearly shifts to the "blue" region at the same speed as the dispersion line shifts to the "red" one.

articleTitle: An Approach to Classifying Walton's Argumentation Schemes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The work is devoted to the study of argumentation in scientific communication texts. The paper focuses on typical models of reasoning characteristic of text genres under consideration. The description is based on Duglas Walton’s compendium of argumentation schemes. Structural argumentation models are fixed using a system of related statements and a classification of these structures according to various adopted criteria. Four classification parameters are introduced: type of conclusion, persuasion grounds, ontological-semantic relation, and target of attack. The advantage of multi-aspect classification in comparison with a simple flat one is the possibility of independent analysis and use by annotators and analysts of various pragmatic and semantic aspects of the arguments involved in the argumentation schemes. In addition, such classification allows, if necessary, to add new classification parameters and values, to introduce missing schemes and classes of schemes needed to represent the argumentative content of texts related to the genres under study.

articleTitle: Development of a Breast Mock-up for Thermographic Diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Infrared thermography is a non-invasive method for diagnosing both superficial and internal pathologies in a number of common socially significant diseases. Zones of temperature deviation from the surface average value are recorded on thermograms for inflammatory processes, as well as for breast cancer. The thermographic picture of volumetric formations makes it possible to assess their shape, size and location. Breast cancer is the most common cancer in the world according to the World Health Organization. In this paper, a simulation of the thermal distribution on the surface of the breast in the presence of pathology is performed. As a model of biological tissue, a three-dimensional element is considered, the geometric shape of which represents a model of the breast, consisting of several layers that imitate the main tissue layers and spherical inclusions imitate manifestations of three-dimensional pathology. An inhomogeneous heat conduction equation was used for mathematical modeling. The Runge-Kutta method of the 4th order is implemented for the numerical solution of equation. Comparison of the simulation result with real thermograms shows that the selected mathematical model correctly describes the change in the temperature of the breast surface in the presence of pathology. INKULEN PE-500 (Plastmass Group Russia) was selected as the material for a breast mock-up. Its density, specific heat capacity and thermal conductivity was calculated and measured. Modeling for the PE-500 material chosen for the mock-up showed a qualitative correspondence between the temperature distribution over the surface of the mock-up and the breast.

articleTitle: Modeling of Methylated DNA Determination by Means of Ultrashort Laser Pulses
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The use of ultrashort laser pulses for the analysis of biomolecules as an alternative to DNA sequencing by Sanger is discussed in this paper. A theory is proposed describing the interaction of a laser pulse with a polyatomic molecular structure, on the basis of which the process is modeled. Of interest is methylated DNA – this is DNA having methyl centers, whose presence or absence affects the work of the cell. Today, the detection of methyl groups by gel electrophoresis occurs with the pre-preparation of the sample using a chemical reaction: bisulfite sequencing converts methylcytosine into thymine. Violation of the DNA structure by initial preparation can introduce errors in the analysis. The use of ultrashort laser pulses can save the study from the stage of chemical preparation of the molecule. The task of this work is to test the proposed mathematical apparatus for decoding the obtained interaction spectra. The scattering of a laser pulse on DNA methylcytosine has been simulated. The obtained scattering spectra showed characteristic differences for both cases, which indicates the effectiveness of the method. The data can be used for research in medicine, biophysics.

articleTitle: Automated Testing of Functional Requirements for Virtual Reality Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: As the virtual reality (VR) application landscape continues to expand exponentially, the software industry faces an increasingly critical need for advanced tools to ensure the quality of these applications. This paper meticulously assesses the strengths and weaknesses of existing solutions designed for the automated testing of VR applications. It introduces an innovative approach that combines traditional test coverage parameters, including GUI, API, performance requirements, load requirements, and user scenarios, with a specialized focus on usability testing. This usability testing involves simulating real-world interactions within a VR application using commonly available VR input devices. Notably, the paper outlines the development of a program rooted in this methodology, significantly enhancing the testing process by eliminating the requirement for a VR headset. Instead, standard input devices such as a keyboard and mouse are utilized as controllers, providing a practical and comprehensive means of ensuring the quality and functionality of VR applications in a rapidly evolving industry.

articleTitle: Adjustment of the Method for Estimating the Volume Level of a Signal with Arbitrary Intensity and Frequency in Sound Dosimetry Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper describes a modified method for determining the volume level of a signal with an arbitrary frequency and intensity, taking into account resonances in the mid-frequency region of the outer ear of the peripheral part of the human auditory system for sound dosimetry tasks. As an element providing mid-frequency amplification, an amplifier with a frequency-dependent amplitude-frequency characteristic was introduced into the measurement model, the amplification function of which is based on the Gaussian function with adjustment by three parameters, which simplifies and automates its adjustment. Using a modified model and a software-implemented amplifier, the volume level was assessed for two types of noise with amplification in the mid-frequency region, which made it possible to take into account the structural features of the human auditory canal during measurements and calculations. The results of the work can be used to determine the volume levels of the noise regime at a certain facility or enterprise, which will make it possible to detect the presence of corresponding risks of irreversible damage to the hearing of personnel in the noise exposure area, as well as to preliminarily and adequately protect the human auditory system from the effects of noise exposure.

articleTitle: Audit of Significant Objects of Critical Information Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The increasing importance of protecting critical information infrastructures has emerged as a top concern in the realm of information security. This heightened focus stems from the potential for an intruder's successful attack to disrupt essential functions within various sectors of a nation. To preemptively mitigate the repercussions of such attacks on information security systems, prioritizing the timely detection of vulnerabilities is paramount. Conducting audits represent the most effective approach in identifying potential weaknesses. However, the current standard offered by regulators for audit outcomes remains limited to a binary "pass/fail" result. Nevertheless, the audit methodology expounded upon in this article introduces a novel visualization technique empowering stakeholders to discern all discernible gaps present within the information protection system of a critical information infrastructure entity. By expanding upon the conventional binary framework, this approach enables a more nuanced understanding of security vulnerabilities and enhances overall preparedness efforts. Also, this audit methodology empowers organizations to proactively improve their security posture.

articleTitle: Matching Diode Laser Radiation With Single-Mode Optical Fiber
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: When matching the radiation of a diode laser with an external cavity with an optical fiber, it was found that the transmission of a single-mode fiber used in most external electro-optical modulators is about 3.2%. The serial connection of multimode and single-mode fiber allows to increase the transmittance of the last one by 2.7 times (up to 8.4%). Moreover, when the injection current changes from 60 to 90 mA, the transmission of various types of optical fibers remains unchanged. The distribution of the intensity of the light beam recorded by the CCD camera at the laser output showed that the horizontal and vertical dimensions differ by about two times (0.8 and 1.6 mm). After passing the optical fiber, the cross-section shape of the light beam becomes close to the correct circle. With increasing distance from the output of the optical fiber, the dimensions of the light beam change linearly. At distances comparable to the cell size (about 20 cm), about 0.6 mm remains, which is significantly smaller than the beam size at the laser output. The obtained data can be further used for external modulation of radiation propagating in the fiber and registration of CPT resonances in a cell with rubidium-87.

articleTitle: About the Problems of System Design of Machine-electric Generating Systems for Autonomous Objects
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: From the standpoint of system design requirements at the level of a technical proposal, a new structural-algorithmic solution for the machine-electric generating system of the 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> type —MEGS-2, previously known in aircraft electrical power engineering as a VSCF system – (variable speed - constant frequency), is considered. The key idea of structural-algorithmic synthesis (SAS) of a four-link system structure (in the form of a series-connected electric generator, rectifier unit, three-phase voltage inverter (TVI) and output filter) is the transition of the phase module of the TVI from the half-bridge structure to the full-bridge. This made it possible to reduce the operating voltage on the transistors by 2 times, and also reduce the installed power of the electric generator. A special feature of the SAS is the use of the principle of multichannel energy flow conversion in each of the three links (in the electric generator, rectifier unit and TVI), which makes it possible to improve their electromagnetic compatibility, weight and size indicators of MEGS-2 and expand the scope of its application in the power range. Under the assumptions made, the results of studies of the properties and performance of this system, obtained on the basis of computer simulation (using Cadence OrCAD Capture), are presented, and on this basis its advantages are formulated.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining Technologies for Processing Results of Experimental Studies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper discusses the components of data mining technology used to process the results of measurements of wheat biopotentials. Briefly described are the goals of studies of plant biopotentials, the conditions and features of measurements and the measuring installation. The results of compression of measurements are presented, which are subjected to further analysis, the methods of data normalization available in the Python programming environment are listed, the choice of clustering methods is justified and the results of their application are given. The advantages of normalizing aggregated biopotential data by the MaxAbsScaler method are concluded. As for clustering methods, the best results were shown by the Bisecting KMeans and SpectralClustering methods, which are part of the group of methods designed to work with a small number of clusters and data. It is noted that among cluster-scalable clustering methods, the GaussianMixture method has an advantage. The absence (due to sufficiently voluminous result tables) of the analysis of the influence of aggregation methods (more precisely, preliminary processing of measured signals - their centering, low-frequency filtering, differentiation) on the results of clustering is motivated. Methods for evaluating the effectiveness of the experiment plan and the direction of further research are proposed.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Recommender System Algorithm's Quality Through the Utilization of Affinity Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The demand for auxiliary systems that utilize methods and technologies of intellectual data analysis and machine learning is increasing in the CRM system development field. These systems are capable of generating valuable insights from vast amounts of data collected in CRM. The article shows the results of the development and study of the CRM system using the methods of affinity analysis. Earlier, the authors developed and implemented the base version of the recommender algorithm based on the use of cluster data analysis and collaborative filtration [1],[2]. The new version of the algorithm additionally uses affinity analysis methods to form recommendations for the selection of products, which made it possible to increase the accuracy of the recommendation system (service) by metrics F2 on average from 67.98% to 81.24% with an increase in the time for issuing recommendations (On average by 2.47 ms). The study and comparison of the basic and modified versions of the algorithm were executed using data sourced from insurance companies, furnished by "FB Consult".

articleTitle: Studying C–V Characteristics of MIS Structures with PE-ALD Al2O3 on HgCdTe Oxidized in Remote RF-Plasma
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Metal–insulator–semiconductor (MIS) structures have been made on narrowband n- and p-Hg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>Cd<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Te(x ≈ 0.22) preliminary chemically cleaned and then oxidized in remote oxygen plasma. Plasma was supplied by an RF generator within a commercial system for plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PE-ALD). An Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> insulating film was deposited on prepared HgCdTe in this system without exposing samples to the ambient atmosphere. HgCdTe epitaxial films comprising or not a surface graded-gap layer (SGGL) have been examined, to reveal its contribution to the electrical properties of the structures. Obtained MIS C–V characteristics reveal near-ideal low-frequency behavior with weak stretching and a narrow hysteresis loop due to low densities of fast and slow surface states. The effective insulator fixed charge has a negative sign with a density of ~1∙10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup>. There is no "p-to-n" conductivity type conversion in the structures on HgCdTe grown without the SGGL. The obtained results can be useful for development of HgCdTe-based devices. The proposed passivation approach is compatible with a technology of HgCdTe focal plane arrays (FPAs) manufacturing.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Optical Planar Fiber Luminescent Antennas for Laser Telecommunications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: There are significant opportunities for polymer film and fiber fluorescent converters, luminescent antennas (LA), in the construction of laser telecommunication systems. In contrast to lens and reflective optical elements, they have a larger area and low weight, and have large field angles. Due to the total internal reflection of luminescence radiation in a planar (film) or cylindrical (optical fiber) waveguide, signal concentration occurs at the output ends, which can be connected directly to photodetectors or through optical cables. Theoretical estimates show that in the ultraviolet (UV) range, ideally, at least 30 UV photons are required to receive one bit of information with an error probability of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup>, but given the real noise characteristics of UV receivers, this estimate must be increased by one or two orders of magnitude, which is confirmed experimentally. The performance rate of polymer converters is determined by the phosphor excitation time, which is several ns, which will allow to obtain the bandwidth of multi-wave UV telecommunication systems up to several Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Generator And Oscilloscope Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article has been described development of the new time domain measurements method of temporal characteristics of non-linear paths with spectrum frequency transfer. Disadvantages of the method, which consist in the ambiguity of group delay time measurements, which occurs in case the measurement channel delay exceeds the reference channel delay have been identified and corrected with the help of some technical solutions. These solutions include ensuring the independence of measurements of the group delay, as well as by synchronizing measurements and taking into account combination frequencies. Measurement stand of novel method described. The settings and elements of microwave paths that are required to make measurements has been described. The model of error has been investigated and described. Example of model error for frequency transfer paths in time domain measurements demonstrated. Software for measurements has been developed. Algorithm of measurement software has been described. Metrological characteristic has been investigated and compared with other non-linear measurement method with using vector network analyzers.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Influence of Heterostructure on the Parameters of Microwave Transistors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents an approach to the selection of the optimal heterostructure to ensure the specified parameters of HEMT. The parameters of four heterostructures with different parameters were analyzed in the framework of the study. Test transistor elements were fabricated on each of the heterostructures using 0.15 μm pHEMT process technology. The following parameters were measured: drain current per unit channel length at gate voltage equal to zero; maximum drain current per unit channel length; transistor cutoff voltage at drain current equal to 1 mA/mm; maximum transistor steepness value. As a result of analyzing the obtained data, a structure with carrier mobility in the channel of 5005 cm2/(V-s) and σ-doping concentration in AlGaAs of 1,31•10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> was selected. Also, a related task was to determine the optimal etching time of the gate recess. As a result of the analysis, the optimal etching time was 1.5 min. At this etching time, the greatest coincidence of transistor characteristics with the required values is ensured.

articleTitle: Tunable Impedance Transformer Based on J-Invertors for Load Modulated Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article explores the circuit design procedure for tuneable impedance transformers utilizing lumped elements J-inverters. Proposed device based on a capacitive Π-circuit of the J-inverter facilitates the electronic tuning of wave impedance. With the ability to electronically tune wave impedance, the performance and efficiency of various electronic systems and devices can be enhanced. The required range of tuneable capacitance to achieve the desired tuning impedance range is obtained based on load–pull analysis of the power amplifier that employed for load modulation techniques. The required range of tuning capacitors of the Π-circuit is determined using analytical analysis, which is discussed in this article. The impedance transformer schematic model based on real component parameters is described in detail. The tuneable impedance transformer layout has been designed and fabricated. The main tuned element of the circuit is the varactor. The measured results demonstrate that the tuneable impedance transformers can effectively adjust the impedance of a circuit within the range of 4Ω to 30Ω at 2.5 GHz.

articleTitle: Analysis of Mathematical Modeling Model in Power Supply Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Today, the modern power supply of industrial enterprises is a complex system of cybernetic type characterized by a large number of interconnected elements and subsystems. The study of such systems is impossible without the use of sufficiently powerful mathematical hardware and digital computers. The ever-increasing pace of electrification of the national economy and the provision of energy to the workforce leads to the need for mass design and development of power supply systems. The scope of this work is so great that it will be absolutely necessary to reduce labor costs for this work. Nowadays, the electrical system also includes control elements that change and regulate the state of the system or the mode of operation of the system. To calculate the system mode, it is necessary to work on a mathematical apparatus. A large number of mathematical methods accumulated over the centuries can be taken ready-made or partially designed by oneself. Mechanical processes related to electricity must be taken into account in the study of transmission, distribution and control systems in the production of electricity. Emergency transitions in the electrical system can occur any sudden emergency changes in the mode and can cause short circuits in the system. In this paper, the problem can be solved by automating the design of power supply systems, as well as using modern mathematical methods and their software.

articleTitle: Simulating an Asymmetric Structure with Double Modal Reservation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article continues research on modal reservation, which is a new approach to the layout and routing of cold redundancy circuits. This approach has proved its efficiency in reducing the impact of broadband interference on radio electronic equipment. This work presents a microstrip structure with a double modal reservation in structures with asymmetric conductors and investigates the influence of such configuration on the time domain characteristics. The analysis of the characteristics of various asymmetry options allowed determining five sets of parameters, under which it is possible to equalize the amplitudes of at least 2 out of 3 pulses. It was found that the set determined by the arrangement of w<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>≠w<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>≠w<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>; s<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>=s<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> possesses the smallest amplitude before failures because of the approximate equalization of the amplitudes of the three pulses. The analysis of the values of maximum amplitudes after failures for all sets showed that after failures in set 2 the lowest value of the maximum amplitude is achieved, which does not exceed the level of 0.51 V. Maximum amplitude value before failures in Set 2 is 5.93% lower than in Set 1. Therefore, when tracing three-wire printed circuit board structures with modal reservation made of FR-4 material, Set 2 that features a changed width of the central conductor is the most promising. Thus, the obtained results showed that the introduction of conductor asymmetry into a structure with a double modal reservation can improve its characteristics in the time domain.

articleTitle: Data Structure Sparse Table
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article discusses the sparse table data structure: description, capabilities, and scope of application. The results of comparison with such data structures as a segment tree and a sqrt decomposition for two problems are shown. Sparse Table is a data structure, that allows answering static range queries. It can answer most range queries in O(log n), but it efficiently answers range minimum queries (or equivalent range maximum queries) in O(1) time. It does preprocessing beforehand so that the queries can be answered efficiently. The origin of the data structure is related to the graph term lowest common ancestor. In graph theory and computer science, the lowest common ancestor (also called least common ancestor) of two nodes v and w in a tree or directed acyclic graph T is the lowest (i.e. deepest) node that has both v and w as descendants, where we define each node to be a descendant of itself (so if v has a direct connection from w, w is the lowest common ancestor). We can solve the problem of finding the least common ancestor using a sparse table. The listing codes are presented in the C++ programming language.

articleTitle: Application of 3D Airborne Electrical Survey Data Processing in a Distributed Computing System when Solving the Problem of Searching for Polymetallic Ores
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An example of the use of 3D processing of airborne electrical survey data in solving the problem of searching for polymetallic ores is presented. Data processing is based on solving a 3D inverse problem, in which the field from the geoelectric model and the field of influence of its individual parameters are calculated using finite element 3D modeling. To solve the inverse problem, a heterogeneous distributed computing system is used. It consists of multi-core computers connected by a network. The paper presents the mathematical model used to solve the inverse problem and some features of the implementation of calculations in a distributed system, which are related to taking into account the computational complexity of the subtasks and the load on the computing nodes by other applications. The results of testing the 3D inversion system on airborne electrical survey data obtained at a polymetallic ore deposit are presented. The 3D inversion results show good agreement with the drilling data.

articleTitle: Automating the Transition from Dialectal to Literary Forms in Uzbek Language Texts: An Algorithmic Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the development of an algorithm for processing dialect variants of the Uzbek language. The main goal of the study is to automate the process of converting dialect word forms into their standard literary analogues. The authors discusses a dictionary approach, which requires using of two databases representing analyzed words. These dictionary databases consist of the words in North Oguz and South Khorezm dialects of the Uzbek language and their association with their literary equivalents.The results of testing demonstrate the good accuracy of the algorithm for words that are in the database of dialect analogues, while when working with word forms that are not in the databases, the accuracy percentage decreases significantly. The proposed approach can be improved, as the authors discuss in the conclusion section. The results of the work can be applied in problems of machine translation, information retrieval, lexical and semantic text processing, as well as in areas related to the study and preservation of linguistic diversity.

articleTitle: Thermal Analysis of 3D Heterogeneous Integration for Microwave HEMTs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of thermal simulation of a new compact approach to heterogeneous integration of GaN-on-SiC HEMT and GaAs pHEMT on a dielectric substrate by flip-chip with low-pitch interconnections are presented in the paper. The cover is connected to the back side of the chip and the periphery of the dielectric substrate with solder preform. The proposed approach provides a solution, suitable for millimeter-wave chip packaging and surface-mount device assembly. Three-dimensional heat calculations were carried out to assess the temperature distribution and thermal resistance. The overall thermal resistance of the circuit is 13 % and 32 % less than the conventional assembly approach for GaN-on-SiC HEMT and GaAs pHEMT, respectively. The influence of the thickness of interconnections is shown. It has been found that using a SiC dielectric substrate compared to Si, achieve thermal resistance values less by 13 % and 10 % for GaN-on-SiC HEMT and GaAs pHEMT, respectively. The parameters of equivalent thermal circuits are determined, which quantitatively show the distribution of thermal resistance of individual structural elements.

articleTitle: Management of the Cyber Range Functionality Based on the Analysis of the Digital Footprint of Students
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article discusses new approaches to teaching students and conducting scientific research in the context of information security. It is crucial to provide students with hands-on learning: emulating and simulating a variety of information assets, resources and a complex network infrastructure. One of the options for solving the problem can be the usage of a cyber range that imitates the structure of the information system of some hypothetical organization. Cyber ranges provide an opportunity for students to act both as defending or intruding parties, teaching different skills and mindsets. The paper considers the development of an intellectual service - a virtual assistant, backed with cybersecurity ontology, which is capable of supporting the cyber range’s users with educational material and advice. Such an approach eases the teachers’ job on the one hand, and allows us to analyze the learning process along the digital trail of students to adjust it and make it more efficient. It is assumed that the description of the protection technology, as well as the virtual assistant’s ontology database, are not secret, however, they must be reliably protected from deliberate forgery. In our case, such protection is provided by blockchain technology.

articleTitle: Digital Twin of a Vibration System for Active Geomonitoring of the Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of constructing a digital twin of a vibration geophysical system for active geophysical monitoring of the environment is considered. The system is used to probe complex media in the "lithosphere-atmosphere-hydrosphere" complex in order to monitor the dynamically changing geophysical characteristics of media in time and space. First of all, this concerns seismic-volcano-hazardous zones, landslide areas, areas of quarry and nuclear explosions, etc. in order to develop methods for predicting catastrophic phenomena - earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, etc. An example of such a seismically active zone is the Baikal Rift Zone. The functioning of the virtual part of the digital twin of a vibration geophysical system is based on multifactor equations for the propagation and processing of vibration oscillations in complex environments. Such equations determine the main components of the digital twin, the connections between them and the simulation modes that underlie the digital twin. The implementation of the virtual digital model is provided using the Manufacturing and Transportation Simulation System simulation modeling system. The system is a visually interactive processor-oriented simulation modeling system for technical systems and technological processes.

articleTitle: Comparison of Routing Methods in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Nowadays, the use of wireless sensor networks is increasing significantly. In sensor networks, wireless sensor nodes are used to monitor surrounding objects, collect data as a result of monitoring and transmit them to users. The main devices of sensor networks are a network of devices consisting of sensor nodes, processors, a receiver and memory device, and a power source (Fig. 1). The affordability and rapid deployment of wireless sensor networks make them reliable for real-time applications. The main challenge of wireless sensor network is long-term energy supply. A lot of research is being done to improve energy efficiency in wireless sensor networks. Scientists are proposing various algorithms for effective use of network energy. Energy resources, energy harvesting, network topology and efficient routing extend network lifetime, wireless sensor network energy is improved by this efficient method. The proposed method relies heavily on grouping and selecting the best path. In this article, we will look at the available routing methods.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of the Device for Determining Aircraft Hydraulic System Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: When investigating and diagnosing the technical condition of the hydraulic system or the aircraft, it is required to use the results of measurements of the flow and temperature of liquid in pipelines. On the basis of the specified requirements for flow and temperature transducers, it is most reasonable to use the thermoconvective method of constant temperature. Therefore, a thermoconvective transducer of flow and temperature of liquid has been developed. For parametric identification, an algorithm of composition of the following methods was used: steepest descent, quasi-Newton and coordinate methods. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in the conditions under consideration is proved by mathematical simulation of the model parameters vector optimal estimation procedure. Determination of the identified parameters estimates uncertainty was carried out according to the method based on the construction of joint confidence intervals of the required parameters estimates with a confidence probability α= 0.95. The calculated uncertainty of the parameter estimates was carried out at the flow measurement error δ= 3%.

articleTitle: Modernisation of Processes for the Formation of Sight Marks, Scales and Grids Based on the Latest Direct Laser Recording Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents the results on the use of laser technologies in the production of new generation optical and optoelectronic devices. The positive effect is achieved by increasing the productivity of laser installations by increasing the speed of grid patterning for optical devices and complexes. Technologies of direct laser recording by focused laser radiation over photosensitive materials with circular scanning and direct laser engraving by femtosecond pulses of the surface of glass substrates of optical quality are considered. The results on creation of flexible production based on laser three-dimensional micromachining of optical components and continuous radial scanning at JSC "Novosibirsk Instrument-Making Plant" are presented. The article shows that modern laser technological processes based on direct laser recording of structures, including those on glass surfaces of optical quality, introduced into the technological process demonstrate their significant efficiency and reproducibility. This makes it possible to significantly extend the duration of the production cycle of manufacturing of a number of serial devices. As practical and comparative analyses show, direct laser recording technologies allow the mass production of scales with strokes less than 1 µm wide and other objects with microstructural topology.

articleTitle: Computing Technology Acoustic Inversion Engineering Seismic Data and Its Application for Construction Purposes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The Shallow-depth engineering seismic studies are carried out in the upper part of the geological section, which is characterized by sharp vertical and horizontal variability of the physical properties of rocks. Additional difficulties in observing and recording caused by seismic vibrations of the soil are associated with the influence of unavoidable interference: ground (wind, sound noise), geological interference (noise of rock cracking during unloading of tectonic stress), man-made interference (the influence of power lines on signal reception, trembling of the soil during the work of construction or quarry mechanisms, cars, trains). The allocation of a useful signal against the background of interference requires the organization of seismic work with repeated repetition of excitations - the accumulation of signals, as well as the development of special computational algorithms and the use of new technologies for processing engineering seismic data. The article considers a computational algorithm of acoustic inversion, which transforms a wave seismic section into a discrete section of pulsed reactions of the medium - effective reflection coefficients. It has a compact discrete appearance and is easier for visual observation and further physico-geological interpretation. The computer technology of application of the acoustic inversion algorithm is implemented. The application of this technology to real engineering seismic data obtained on the territory of the construction of a high-rise building made it possible to determine the parameters of the geological foundation lying under the ground surface of the construction site, namely: the depth of occurrence, relief, areas of increased disintegration. The established properties of the geological foundation are necessary for the analysis of the strength and stability of soils during the construction and operation of a high-rise structure for its safety.

articleTitle: Influence of Fittings of Drill Pipe Ultrasonic Signal Dampening in a Well
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The telemetry transfer from the bottom to the wellhead is an urgent problem that does not have a general-purpose solution. The paper presents studies aimed at the effect of drill locks and foreign conductive objects on the ultrasonic signal attenuation. Ultrasonic receiver and transmitter based on TR60-10H0Z-01 piezoelectric elements were used for measurements. The frequency of the transmitted signal is 60 kHz. The measurements were carried out on an experimental setup representing a six-meter-long pipe, in which the transmitter moved freely. Regression analysis follows a nonlinear attenuation model in a pipe filled with water, with a drill lock, and filled with air. It was found that one drill lock in the pipe reduces the signal level by 18 %. At the same time, the attenuation model without the linear component remains the same. Modeling of the attenuation level over a longer distance when using drill locks in pipes of 8.3 m showed that a decrease of the signal amplitude to the noise level would occur to 400 m. For comparison, a damping model was obtained for an ultrasonic signal in an empty waveguide.

articleTitle: Methodology of Teaching Subjects Based on Mobile Technologies in Higher Education Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this scientific article, the content and functions of creating interactive mobile educational resources in the electronic educational environment and the development of teaching based on them, analyzing the methodology, management models and tools, and developing recommendations for the development of the system of creating interactive mobile educational resources are studied in detail. It has been scientifically proven that the development of teaching on the basis of interactive mobile learning technologies, the search for knowledge, its understanding, strengthening, the formation of special knowledge, and the generalization and systematization of knowledge have an important place in higher education institutions.
