The analysis carried out as part of this scientific research includes the following:analysis of literature on the method of creating and using interactive mobile educational resources in the electronic educational environment, development of models and software tools for creating interactive mobile educational resources;creation of mobile educational resources and levels of use in education, electronic resources for transfer of educational materials, content and functions of using interactive mobile educational resources.The technology of creating interactive mobile educational resources in the electronic educational environment, the method of using interactive educational resources, and the development of the model of teaching methods of subjects based on mobile technologies in higher education institutions will be scientifically and practically demonstrated.

articleTitle: Developing Rule-Based and Gazetteer Lists for Named Entity Recognition in Uzbek Language: Geographical Names
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Named entity recognition is one of the current problems in the field of natural language processing, especially for languages with limited resources, where the Uzbek language is one of them. In this scientific work, the authors conduct a review study and also propose a practical solution for recognizing named entities in the Uzbek language. The proposed approach is designed and operated on the basis of gazetteer rules and lists, with special emphasis on the identification of place names. The authors do not use machine learning methods due to limited linguistic resources, which makes the proposed approach easy to implement and fast to scale.The cornerstone of the proposed approach is two algorithms, where the first algorithm, based on morphological analysis, despite its simplicity, is somewhat limited in its capabilities. Conversely, the second algorithm is based on the syntactic analysis of texts in the Uzbek language and offers a more flexible approach to recognizing named entities.Both algorithms use a specific set of rules obtained as a result of a detailed study of the structure of the Uzbek language and its morphological and grammatical features.The purpose of this study is to enrich the relatively sparse literature on named entity recognition in the Uzbek language and to provide a solid basis for continued research in this area.

articleTitle: The Problem of Refining Methane Drainage Technology of the Tutuyasskaya Area in Kuzbass, Russia
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Due to the high gas content in the Kuznetsk Coal Basin, degasification has become an integral part of the mining operation process. Nowadays, the integrated approach is needed to plan and design degassing wells more properly for an industrial safety support and a coal bed methane drainage borehole ratio increasing. This research presents the first stage of a 3D geological models creation – the wireframe modeling of the Tutuyasskaya Area southern part. The modeling was carried out using the mining and geological information system (MGIS) Micromine Origin&Beyond. The analysis of the initial geological, surveying and geological exploration information is carried out. The exploration wells database was created based on the data processing in MGIS. The results of drillholes database creation, digital terrain model (DTM) generation and wireframe building of disjunctive geological faults are illustrated in the research. The process of a data preparation for geological block modeling and coal seams properties and quality interpolation is described thoroughly. The results of further stages – block geological and subsequent geomechanical modeling processes make it possible to analyze the distributions of the main stresses in the rock massif and to plan the degassing wells scheme.

articleTitle: Printed Direction Finding Antenna Array Based on a Center-End Feed Dipole-Like Radiator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article analyses a dipole-like radiator with a central-end feed. On the base of the method of induced electromotive forces and mirror images, expressions for the description of the input impedance of the radiator above ground have been obtained. According to the results of calculations the graphs of dependences of real and imaginary parts of the complex input impedance of the dipole-like radiator with center-end feed on the height above the ground are plotted, which can be used in the future for the formation of the initial antenna topology. Electrodynamic models of printed antenna arrays with sum and difference radiation patterns based on a center-end fed dipole-like radiator are presented. Using the simulation results, a prototype antenna with difference radiation pattern has been designed and synthesized. The presented prototype is characterized by a high matching degree between the experimental and simulated characteristics. The proposed antenna with a differential radiation pattern can be used in radiolocation equipment, radio monitoring and radio control system.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of the Resolution of Marine Electromagnetic Technologies in the Time and Frequency Domains
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A comparative analysis of marine controlled source electromagnetic technologies in the frequency (FD CSEM) and time (TD CSEM) domains for solving hydrocarbon exploration problems is presented. One of the important goals of the research is to develop requirements for measuring equipment in order to increase the level of anomalous signal from the target, improve the signal-to-magnetotelluric (MT) noise ratio, and also reduce the influence of geological interference. The analysis was carried out using 3D finite element modeling for geoelectrical models corresponding to real oil and gas fields. It is shown that TD CSEM method allows us to obtain a significantly larger relative response from the resistivity anomaly at a high absolute value of the anomalous signal in comparison with FD CSEM method. The signal-to-noise ratio in TD CSEM method is at least no worse than in FD CSEM method. It is also shown that both methods are sensitive to geological interference such as salt bodies and near-seabed heterogeneities, but their influence can be reliably excluded by using measurements at different time channels for TD CSEM method or frequencies for FD CSEM method.

Author Keywords: time domain control source electromagnetic method
frequency domain control source electromagnetic method

articleTitle: Modeling and Numerical Solving of the Process of Separating Grain Mixtures by a Centrifugal Separator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper developed a mathematical model of the process of separating grain mixtures that describes the movement of particles in a centrifugal separator. When developing a mathematical model of the technological process, the following parameters were taken into account: centrifugal force of inertia; normal reaction force, gravity, particle drag in the Oxyz system; portable force acting on particles; Coriolis force of inertia. To solve the problem, a numerical algorithm and software tools were developed and computational experiments were carried out for various values of the parameters of the process under consideration. The results of the calculations performed are shown in the form of graphical objects and the analysis of the results of the studies is given in the conclusion of this work. The developed mathematical model and numerical method allows us to determine the range of parameters of the separating unit, taking into account the physical and mechanical properties of the particles.

articleTitle: Detecting Money Laundering Patterns through Cash Flow Analysis: a Neural Network-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Money laundering poses a serious threat to the international financial system and requires effective detection methods. The techniques used by reporting entities in the AML/CFT regime may be incapable of identifying advanced financial frauds that have a convoluted nature as well as of processing large amounts of data. This paper builds an ANN based on analyzing cash flows in bank statements in order to identify patterns of money laundering. The toolkit is automated using Python programming language in Jupyter Notebook. The efficiency of the ANN is evaluated using ROC curves and a confusion matrix. In addition, the accuracy of the ANN is compared with that of other common machine learning models, including decision trees, random forest and gradient boosting. The results demonstrate the high efficiency of the ANN, which indicates the rationality and feasibility of the neural network-based approach to cash flow analysis for the purpose of identifying money laundering patterns. The toolkit is recommended for adoption in the operational processes of reporting entities to improve the quality of internal control for AML/CFT purposes.

articleTitle: Application of IEC 60870 and 61850 Standards in Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The issues of standardization of battery storage systems for electricity (BESS) are considered in this paper. An architecture based on the use of metadata for the specification of Modbus equipment interfaces, markup of the graphical interface of user applications and mapping of graphical interface elements to equipment registers is described. The software architecture of the monitoring and control system (MCS) is described, which allows saving streaming data and recording changes in the state of BESS equipment by polling Modbus registers. The received data is transmitted to the server components of the IEC 60870, IEC 61850 protocols. The coordination of the logical metadata model for IEC 60870 consists in the formal conversion of the equipment Modbus register numbers into the register numbers of the conformed IEC 104 standard. The physical model of the equipment interfaces is reproduced on the client side. The metadata logical model negotiation for IEC 61850 is based on the formal generation of a device configuration description (CID) in the IEC 61850 standard from the metamodel data. For metamodel elements used as sources of streaming data and events, composite attribute names are generated for the internal MMS protocol. In the process of polling the BESS MCS server for Modbus equipment registers, it searches for nodes in the structure of the information model of the IEC 61850 server and updates the attribute values stored in them. Test results are given. The issues of creating BESS equipment profiles are discussed.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Cold Plasma Jet Initiated by Non-Contact and Contact Pulse Voltage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper, the characteristics of a cold atmospheric plasma jet generated by non-contact and contact methods of initiating a gas discharge with a pulsed voltage are investigated. The parameters of current detectabled in the contact zone of the plasma jet touching the object, depending on the amplitude and duration of unipolar positive pulses for contact and non-contact initiation of the discharge, have been studied. The frequency of touching of the plasma jet current with the object under different durations of initiating voltage pulses and pulse repetition frequencies has been investigated. The spectral analysis of the plasma jet interaction zone with object has been carried out. The modes providing the highest intensity of OH radical emission were determined. The temperature increment in the cold plasma jet interaction zone with the object at different parameters of voltage and speed of gas pumped through the device has been investigated. Comparative research of the characteristics of cold plasma jets initiated by contact and non-contact excitation by unipolar positive pulses has been carried out. It is established that the amplitude of the current registered on the object surface is several times higher for the plasma jet initiated by contact excitation of the gas medium. It is shown that at non-contact method of discharge ignition by unipolar positive pulses the frequency of current touching the object of influence matches with the repetition frequency of voltage pulses.

articleTitle: Modern High-Frequency Sound Emitters Distortion Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper compares non-linear and linear distortions of modern high-frequency dome-type dynamic heads and ribbon drivers. Based on an analysis of the electrical characteristics and distortion spectrum of Russian-made high-frequency emitters, recommendations are given for the selection of high-frequency sound emitters in order to build a high-quality near-field audio monitoring system for work in an audio studio. As a criterion for assessing quality, the authors used psychoacoustics-based relationships between the spectral components of non-linear distortion result. In order to reduce the time spent searching for optimal acoustic components for the task of designing a near-field acoustic monitor for an audio studio, the task of searching and selecting serial copies or searching for suitable models of high-frequency sound emitters was posed and solved. The proposed method for selecting specimens can be applied in production using a product quality control system to maintain the high quality of manufactured products and preserve their declared sound properties.

articleTitle: Ant Colony Algorithm for Placing Electronic Components on a Printed Circuit Board, Taking into Account the Thermal Compatibility Criterion*
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of electronic components placing on a printed circuit board of an electronic device is formulated in this paper. The choice of constraints and criteria for the optimization problem is validated. We propose to take into account the thermal compatibility criterion to ensure normal thermal conditions of the printed circuit board. An indicator of the problem solution quality is the maximum temperature of a component among all components placed on a printed circuit board. The temperature of the components is determined based on the solution of the heat balance equation. The ant algorithm for placement problem solving is described. The sequence of vertices of the decision graph in the path formed by the ant colony determines the sequence of elements placement on the mounting plane of the printed circuit board and thus corresponds to the placement problem solution. The decrease in the maximum temperature of the printed circuit board temperature field was assessed depending on the number of the stage of constructing the best path by a ant colony, with different thermal conductivity between the components and the surrounding air environment. The results of computational experiments for effectiveness study of the ant algorithm are presented. The experiments carried out showed the effectiveness of the applied ant algorithm and that rational placement of the electronic components on the PCB makes it possible to reduce the maximum temperature of the components.

articleTitle: Developing a Pulse Wave Model Using the Lumped-Element Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases have a huge tendency to develop and there is a need to develop new diagnostic methods and accurate measurement of blood pressure. Research in the field of pulse wave showed reproducibility of results for assessing the state of the vascular bed by assessing the speed of propagation of the pulse wave, and the correlation of the pulse wave with changes in blood pressure parameters was proved. Modeling a pulse wave, in particular, of the brachial artery allows you to immerse yourself in the process of physiological transmission of parameters from the artery to external structures (for example, a cuff). Modeling using the RLC parameters of the electronic circuit has proven itself due to the possibility of a multi-segment description of the state of the vascular bed, the realistic calculations of the parameters of the electronic circuit, and the established correspondence between the parameters of the electronic circuit and the physiological parameters of hemodynamics.

articleTitle: Determination of the Earth's Gravitational Field Parameters Based on Inter-satellite Measurements between Cubesate-type Nanosatellites
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Design of a space gravitational gradiometer for creation of Earth's gravimetric maps for navigation is proposed in the paper. The operation principle of the gravitational gradiometer is to measure the inter-satellite distance, which changes due to different impact of the earth's gravitational field on the gravitational gradiometer's spacecrafts. It is proposed to measure the inter-satellite distance increments using a Michelson laser interferometer. Different configurations of space gravitational gradiometer for the case of passive reflectors and active signal retranslation are considered. The maximum possible intersatellite distance between satellites at which optical interferometric measurements with passive reflectors can be performed is estimated. A universal structural optical scheme of the laser interferometer for both active and passive satellite configurations is proposed. The main nodes of the laser interferometer are considered: stabilized laser source, optical guidance system and photodetector registration system. The main sources of noise in the proposed interferometer are considered: frequency instability of the laser source and optical frequency retransmission system; angular noise of the pointing system; temperature noise and photodetector noise. The estimation of the noise budget and the contribution of each noise source to the measurement accuracy is given. At the total noise level of about 10-20 pm, the measurement accuracy of the gravitational field gradient is 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup> Eotvos.

articleTitle: The Use of Information-measuring Technologies for the Load Condition Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the present study, a new method of organizing the load condition monitoring based on the use of information and measurement technologies is considered. When calculating the forces, information about digital measurements of instantaneous values of currents, voltages, speed and temperature is involved. The analysis of the existing methods of obtaining information for processing and analyzing data is carried out. The result of the analysis is necessary for reliable monitoring and monitoring of the load condition. A digital twin of the electric motor has been created to calculate the torque. An energy approach lies in the concept of the digital twin. The algorithms for calculating the torque are based on the control of energy transformations in the electric drive. To adapt the digital twin to real processes, a set of constants is used, tied to the design features of the electric motor. A comparison of the experimental and the results obtained from the data of the digital twin is carried out. The simulation results confirmed the coincidence of the calculated and passport characteristics with the required (1...3) % accuracy for condition monitoring.

articleTitle: Features of Smartphone Diagnostics of Human Health Based on Gait Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes trends in the implementation of portable and wearable devices in the field of personalized medicine. The main stages of processing smartphone data to estimate human gait parameters are described. The approaches used are considered and the problems of practical implementation of technology for assessing health parameters using gait parameters using a mobile phone are shown. Special attention is paid to the quality of data collected from the smartphone. To improve the quality of data collected from a smartphone, an algorithm for preliminary automated processing of data from wearable devices is proposed using the example of a smartphone accelerometer. The proposed algorithm takes into account specific time-frequency features of the accelerometer signal in the segmentation procedure and allows selecting the most correlated segments. In practice, the proposed algorithm reduces the appearance of negative anomalous data at the classification stage and increases the reliability of further classification of segments in accordance with changes in human health and increases the reliability of forecast estimates. At the segmentation stage, the probability of selecting false segments is no more than 0.2, and the probability of missing segments is no more than 0.11. Despite the results obtained, the authors note the need to use machine learning methods at the data segmentation stage.

articleTitle: Double Tungstates for Solar Panel Efficiency Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents an in-depth exploration of the potential use of double tungstates and molybdates as spectral converters of light, focusing primarily on their operation based on the down-conversion process. This research is expected to contribute significantly to advancements in solar panel applications, particularly by enhancing their efficiency. The absorption spectra were measured within the infrared spectrum for a group of crystals. This collection comprised two double tungstates, three double molybdates, and one single molybdate, each activated with varying concentrations of ytterbium. The absorption spectra's measurement aimed to investigate the potential of these crystals as spectral converters and determine the impact of the ytterbium concentration on their spectral properties. The ions of Yb³⁺ in the measured crystals exhibit a specific absorption characteristic, which is expected to produce luminescence. It is noteworthy that the luminescence lies near the forbidden zone of crystalline silicon. Crystalline silicon is extensively utilized in the manufacture of solar cells, implying that the observed luminescence could have significant implications for the solar energy industry. The results obtained from this investigation reveal a noteworthy relationship between the concentration of Yb³⁺ ions and the luminescence produced by the crystals. Understanding these relationships could potentially lead to advancements in solar panel technology by improving the panels' efficiency. This research could offer novel insights into the potential use of double tungstates and molybdates in enhancing the efficiency of solar panels. The results obtained here can provide a strong foundation for further research into this promising technology, potentially contributing significantly to the evolution of sustainable energy solutions.

articleTitle: Numerical Homogenization of the Scalar Electrophysical Properties of the Asphalt Concrete Samples
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is focused on studying the effect of the mineral contents on the effective characteristics of the samples modeling the asphalt concrete cores. The two types of samples are considered: the fine-grained sample with pure bitumen binding the regularly arranged inclusions of crushed stone, and the samples with non-regular inclusion arrangement and two-component binder of bitumen with sand. For both types of the samples, several variants of mineral contents were investigated. For the fine-grained samples with a pure bitumen matrix, only the effective dielectric permittivity is considered because the pure bitumen resin is non-conductive. Despite the significant difference in the relative effective permittivity of the component materials, the changes in the contents of the fine-grained samples had a small effect due to the low concentration of the inclusions. In contrast, for the multicomponent sample, both characteristics are influenced by changes in the mineral content of the samples and can be utilized to indicate such changes.

articleTitle: On Linear Algebraic System Forming in Parametric Identification Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is concerned with parametric identification algorithm for a linear dynamic control object when a priori information about the object is no fully available. In this paper the parametric identification of object is come to estimation of the object mathematical model in the form of n-th order differential equation.Inputs and outputs of object distorted by interference are a priori information for parametric identification problems, while values of these signals derivatives are not available.Estimation of differential equation coefficients is coming to solving the linear algebraic system. In this paper we propose method of forming system of linear algebraic equations using the approach to replace numerical differentiation of the measured signals by differentiating some analytically specified functions. This method is based on integral operators and integration by parts. Functions using in process of forming system of equations satisfy requirements for application in parametric identification problems. It is proposed to use least squares method for solve the system.The article presents simulation results the algorithm study for accuracy and noise immunity depending on the noise frequency properties distorted the output signal.

articleTitle: Organization of Monitoring of Even Harmonics Amplitudes in the Electricity Networks of the Altai Republic as an Indicator of Space Weather
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The system for monitoring the amplitude of current even harmonics in electric networks based on an induction sensor and a digital recorder is developed and constructed. The induction sensor is connected to the differential inputs of 24 bit analog-digital converter directly. Registration is carried out with a frequency of 1 kHz, the maximum sensitivity is achieved at the frequency of the 6th harmonic and is 1.3 mV/nT. For storage efficiency, the recorder records the first 15 seconds of each minute synchronized from the PPS modem in UTC time. Monitoring of even harmonic amplitudes is organized at the Ininskaya electrical substation in the Altai Republic since 28 July 2023. A signal–to–noise ratio is 63 dB. The appearance of a correlation (R=0.3...0.5) between the amplitude of current even harmonics and the rate of change of the horizontally oriented components of the geomagnetic field during moderate magnetic disturbances of 05 August 2023 was found. It indicates the influence of geomagnetically induced currents on the power system of the Altai Republic. The maximum value of the correlation coefficient was observed for the 6th harmonic. It is planned to accumulate further the information during the increasing activity of the current solar cycle.

articleTitle: Errors in Setting the Angular Position in Matrix Simulators due to the Nonlinearity of the Direction Finding Characteristics of the Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The errors of setting the angular position of the apparent center of radiation that occur in matrix simulators of signals and interference are considered. They are caused by the nonlinearity of the direction finding characteristics of the antenna of the radio-electronic system that is being investigated. It is shown that these errors are determined by the fourth degree term in the polynomial, which is used to approximate the radiation pattern of the receiving antenna. In fact, this term determines the nonlinearity of the direction finding characteristics of the antenna of the radio engineering system, which is studied using a matrix simulator. Relations are obtained that establish the relationship of the error magnitude with the diversity of the matrix emitters and the coefficients of the polynomial approximating the antenna pattern. The largest error values are also determined depending on the combination of these parameters. The results obtained can be applied in the design of matrix simulators of signals and interference, and the results can also be used to predict the accuracy characteristics of matrix simulators.

Author Keywords: amplitude method of radio direction finding

articleTitle: Achieving Maximum Torque for Synchronous Reluctance Motor over Its Entire Speed Range
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Synchronous reluctance motor is now popular solution for replacement of induction adjustable speed drives in industrial applications. However, there is no evidence of use of such electrical machines in traction applications. In this paper the speed-torque curve of such motor is obtained helping to understand the properties of the electrical machine and its capability of working in a constant power speed range. The paper considers a model of the motor and develops step-by-step method for achieving maximum torque at any speed in order to plot torque, efficiency, voltage, current, power, apparent power, and power factor. The results show that the synchronous reluctance motor has rapid mitigation of the output power at the speeds above rated making it unsuitable for heavy traction applications. However, it still can be used in non-demanding electric vehicles as a cheap and reliable alternative to the induction or permanent magnet synchronous motors.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Electrophysical Properties of Asphalt Concrete Samples
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Partial or major roadmending is performed on the roads annually. To assess the quality of the work performed, samples are extracted from the laid roadbed and tested in a laboratory. However, the road's integrity is not always restored. The development of a non-contact quality control methodology for paved roads without extracting samples for analysis is an extremely urgent task. The paper presents a numerical study of effective properties of the synthetic samples with internal geometry and electrophysical properties of the components close to the properties of real road pavement samples. the laboratory analysis of which allows to speak about the quality of road repair works. The authors propose a mathematical framework for determining the effective electrophysical characteristics of a heterogeneous medium. The effective characteristic is introduced as a second-rank tensor describing both the effective dielectric permittivity of a complex medium and its electrical conductivity. The simulation is performed in the MHz frequency domain. Two types of mineral filler grades of asphalt concrete mix are considered in this paper: crushed granite and crushed gabbro. The results of numerical simulations showed the dependence on the grade of crushed stone used, as well as on the volume fraction of mineral filler in the asphalt concrete mass. This indicates that it is possible to identify the granulometric content of the road surface.

articleTitle: The Creation and Integration of the Technological Workflow for Software and Hardware-Software Development
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article addresses the life cycle of software and hardware-software projects and provides an examination and systematization of the challenges associated with ensuring network information security throughout each stage, from planning to testing and operation of the developed product. A formalized method, incorporating the use of BPMN diagram, is presented for consideration as a potential approach to construct and implement a technological pipeline for software and hardware-software solution development. The primary objective of this method is to ensure comprehensive information security of the deployed infrastructure throughout the pipeline. This approach aligns with the integrated DevOps and DevSecOps methodologies. The scientific novelty of this work lies in the proposal of a novel algorithm for deploying and maintaining a technological pipeline for software and/or hardware-software product development, which enhances the security of information flows within the pipeline by leveraging virtualization and containerization tools. Unlike existing solutions, this approach achieves increased information resource security by managing information flows at all levels of the TCP/IP protocol stack and automating processes at all stages of the project lifecycle.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of Measurement of Relative Permittivity of Materials Considering External Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This work is dedicated to the questions of measurement the complex relative permittivity of materials under external influencing factors. Was considered the question of a temperature dependence of complex relative permittivity and the main problems, which can be effect on a measurement results, were identified. One of the most important problems during measurement of the temperature dependence of complex relative permittivity is expansion of the sample under the influence of temperature. The temperature expansion of material under test can be calculated for each point of temperature, but the problem is determining the location of the material under test in the sample holder. For minimization of measurement error and location of the material determination in a sample holder after heating in the article was present the mathematical algorithm for automatic calculation the test material location in a sample holder. The paper presents both the mathematical expressions necessary for calculation and the results of applying the proposed approach to real measurements.

articleTitle: Spectral-Time Methods for Analysis and Detection of Vehicle Noise in Geomonitoring Tasks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of passive geophysical monitoring of vehicle objects based on their seismic-acoustic noise is considered. Heavy types of vehicles are considered as sources of vehicle oscillations: electric trains, freight trains, wheeled and tracked vehicles. The statement of the monitoring problem is given. Solving it includes a number of stages. The initial stage of monitoring is associated with the detection of moving vehicles against the background of external noise. The paper proposes two ways to increase the detection range: taking into account the characteristic narrowband frequency components in the oscillation spectrum in one method and broadband ones in the other. The solution is based on combining methods of spectral-time analysis and narrowband filtering of recorded oscillations. The results of the analysis of records of vehicle vibrations obtained in the field are presented. The features of the spectra of seismic and acoustic noise of various types of vehicle are considered. It has been shown that the predominant frequencies of seismic and acoustic oscillations arising during vehicle movement are in the low frequency range. The dependence of the characteristic narrowband frequency component on the speed mode of the vehicle is analyzed.

articleTitle: Use of Gravitational Energy Storage Devices in Electric Drives of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In most transport drives, a significant part of the energy consumed by the drive motors is uselessly extinguished during braking. At the same time, the increase in electricity consumption has a negative impact on the environment, as it leads to pollution of the atmosphere and water. One way to improve the energy efficiency of vehicles is the use of energy storage devices. In the structure of electric energy consumption, electric transport occupies one of the leading positions, so the issues of energy saving, which have become particularly acute recently due to the rising cost of electricity, are becoming more and more important for electric transport. The paper considers a method of increasing the energy efficiency of electric drives for transport purposes by applying gravitational energy storage devices operating in dynamic start-up and braking modes. It is shown that the application of gravitational energy storage device allows to compensate the energy required for acceleration and braking. This makes it possible to significantly reduce the power of the actuating motor to achieve the required characteristics of reproducible movements while maintaining the drive performance. A mathematical apparatus, which allows a reasonable approach to the choice of gravitational energy storage device characteristics, has been developed. The adequacy of the obtained calculation ratios is shown on a specific example.

articleTitle: Radar Cross-section Reduction Microstrip Antenna Vivaldi
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The critical component for effective radar functionality is fundamentally dependent on the Radar Cross-Section. In a preceding scholarly article disseminated through an IEEE symposium, our investigative scope was confined to the explication and prognostication of assorted computational models executed within the framework of CST Microwave Studio software, culminating in a relatively limited set of empirical data. The manuscript at hand constitutes an expansion of the antecedent research by elaborating upon the systematic architectural design of a prototypical antenna using CST Microwave Studio, and by scrutinizing the ramifications of varying angles of polarized plane waves on the radar cross-section.In the aforementioned IEEE symposium paper, we delved into the multifaceted variables that dictate the quantity of electromagnetic radiation reflected back toward the originating radar source in the context of maritime vessels. These contributory elements comprised polarized attributes of incident magnetic oscillation, the incorporation of heterogeneous substances in the structural composition, and the geometrical dimensions of the maritime vessel under examination.The current scholarly work furnishes an exhaustive analytical review of disparate modeling methodologies implemented in CST Microwave Studio for the purpose of estimating the radar cross-section associated with a specified Vivaldi antenna topology. In this evaluative framework, we explore the constellation of variables impacting the magnitude of electromagnetic radiation re-radiated towards the originating radar source when considering a Vivaldi antenna-based vessel. These variables include but are not limited to, the polarized characteristics of magnetic oscillation, the judicious selection of diverse substances in the construction, and the geometrical parameters of the Vivaldi antenna vessel. For the ambit of this manuscript, we introduce a microstrip-based Vivaldi antenna configuration designed to minimize monostatic radar cross-section, achieved through the replacement of a conventional substantial.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Finding a Descriptive Path for Delivering Cargo to Hard-to-Reach Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: At the moment, due to the growing interest in unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV), as well as due to the rapid and constant development of the UAV market and high technologies in the field of artificial intelligence, this branch of robotics has begun to occupy more and more sectors of the economy. With the increasing popularity of fast and light vehicles such as UAVs, the demand for efficient flight path planning algorithms has also increased to achieve a variety of goals: overflight, obstacle detection and collision avoidance. One of these goals is achieved by our algorithm for flying around static obstacles in 3D space in a sparse weighted graph. A hybrid method has been developed for finding the safest and fastest route based on Dijkstra's algorithm, which works with satellite images of various terrain classifications. The novelty of the proposed algorithm lies in the combination of artificial neural networks for categorizing terrain classes and using these data when constructing a flight task. The idea is to build a route on top of the safest terrain so that in the event of an emergency fall or landing, the UAV will not be lost. It is more memory efficient because it does not require storing all the vertices in an open list, as do algorithms that perform a similar task. In addition to the software architecture, the most suitable hardware architecture for the intended purpose - delivering cargo to difficult terrain - is presented.

articleTitle: Broadband Signals Combiner on Suspended Striplines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article discusses a device for combining the power of two generators in a wide frequency band. The device is designed using a bridge circuit, which can be seen as a modification of the classical Wheatstone circuit. The construction of the developed combiner is described. The particular feature is that the device is implemented on transmission lines with frontal coupling. It is shown that this construction allows for expanding the working frequency band and reducing its size. Based on the simulation results, it was determined that the isolation between the input channels can reach 40 dB in the frequency range from 15 MHz to 4000 MHz. The operation of the device for combining two wideband pulses of different polarities, separated in time, is considered. The results of experimental measurements for such a mode of operation are presented. When pulses with amplitudes of 51.5 V and -48.4 V were applied to the combiner inputs, a sum of pulses with amplitudes of 32.5 V and -30.54 V, with a rising front of 1.2 ns, was obtained at the output. The device can be used in tasks related to the detection of nonlinear objects by the methods based on two different polarity pulses.

articleTitle: First-Order Circuits Current Calculation by Method of Differential Equations Algebraization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The simplest equivalent circuits of loads, namely first-order series resistor-inductor and resistor-capacitor circuits, as objects of application of a method of differential equations algebraization are considered in the paper. This method in its various versions has been designed to calculate directly electromagnetic process’ parameters and converters’ power indicators without a solution of the differential equations. Obtaining equations for the RMS values of the above circuits’ currents in the form of asymptotically converging infinite series, the common terms of which depend both on the applied voltage harmonics coefficients and on the parameters’ ratio of the circuits under consideration is described in the paper. As the voltage harmonics coefficients, various orders’ integrated voltage harmonics factors, also known as weighted THD factors, are used in the differential equations algebraization method. They perform summation of harmonics weighted by their numbers, that is modeling the effect of the action of the amplitude-frequency characteristics of the idealized electric circuits of the corresponding orders. The boundary conditions of convergence, which are connecting the parameters of the supply voltage and load, are revealed for the series of both kinds of the circuits.

articleTitle: Numerical Modeling of Eigenfrequencies of Beams with Defects
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Vibration monitoring of structures or their fragments, based on the extraction of eigenfrequencies of vibrations of various origins, are widely used in various applications. For example, to detect defects of pile structures in the underground part. However, in general, such techniques usually detect the presence or absence of changes compared to a reference. However, it is necessary to know the localization and size of the detected defects in order to make recommendations on the possibility of continued exploitation of the structure. Within the framework of this paper, a hyperbolic equation describing the change of stress-strain state in time under the load of a sinusoidal source with linear frequency modulation in the kilohertz range is considered as a mathematical model of propagation of induced vibrations in a beam. A combination of the finite element method on tetrahedral supports and the Newmark scheme in the time domain was used to solve the problem. The eigenfrequencies of beams without defects and beams with kerfs at different distances from the source were analyzed. It is obtained that the addition of a kerf in the beam generates additional eigenmodes compared to the reference. However, in this case, no clear conclusions could be made about the distance of the kerf to the source. Nevertheless, such work is necessary for a more detailed study of the interaction between materials and their characteristics under the conditions of real experimental problems.

articleTitle: Study of Changes in the Electrochemical Parameters of Periodontal Tissues in the Postoperative Period
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The purpose of the study was to study changes in the electrochemical parameters of periodontal tissues in the postoperative period. The relevance of the use of systems based on the electrochemical characteristics of tissues in dentistry is described. The scientific novelty of the study lies in the use of the joulemetric method to study the changes occurring in periodontal tissues during the postoperative period. Compared with classical instrumental diagnostic methods, electrochemical methods have significant advantages. Their main advantages are the simplicity of the equipment used, efficiency, safety for human health, low cost, the ability to assess the state of the object under examination by the obtained parameters characterizing the properties of the object under examination in real time. As a result of statistical processing of the data obtained as a result of the experimental study, it was found that in the study group the current work indicator was 0.157 to 0.351 μJ, and an average of 0.248 μJ. The same indicator in the control group ranged from 0.046 to 0.137 μJ and averaged 0.088 μJ. The difference between the indicators in the control and study groups is the result of the activation of biological processes aimed at tissue regeneration.

articleTitle: Synthesis of an Automatic Control System for the Excitation System of a Three-stage Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is devoted to solving the problem of synthesis of an automatic control system for the excitation unit of a three-stage synchronous generator operating as part of an on-board power supply system. In the starter operation mode, when the excitation unit operating in the configuration of a single-phase voltage source inverter, a single-loop control system with the resonant component and a PI-controller for the current of the excitation winding has been developed. In the generator operation mode, when the excitation unit operating as DC-DC Buck converter, a two-loop control system with PI and PID controllers with main generator output voltage controlling has been created. To calculate the parameters of the controllers, a calculation technique based on the time-scale separation method is considered. The efficiency of the designed system was evaluated on the basis of simulation modeling using the PowerSIM and Matlab/Simulink software for a generator supplying a three-phase AC network, with a 115 V/400 Hz voltage with power quality based on the requirements of GOST R 54073-2017.

articleTitle: Total Energy Flight Speed and Altitude Control for a Small UAV: Simulation and Flight Experiment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Comparative results of a real flight experiment and a flight simulation of a small UAV are presented. A longitudinal motion control system is developed using a total energy approach. The outputs of the total energy controller are converted into control signals for deflecting the aircraft's rudders in pitch and roll, as well as into an engine thrust command. The model of the aircraft's motion is obtained in the form of tabular dependencies of the dimensionless coefficients of forces and moments on the angles of attack, slip, and elevon deflection angles. The total energy control method was tested for a small flying wing-type aircraft. The aircraft is made on the basis of the ArWing Classic radio-controlled aircraft kit. During the simulation process, two modes were used on the stand: capturing and maintaining altitude and capturing the angle of inclination of the trajectory; in the flight experiment, the capturing and maintaining altitude mode was used. The structure of the control system, the results of modeling and a real flight experiment are presented.

articleTitle: Influence of Digital Map Discreteness on Low Angle Land Clutter Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The earth’s surface can be divided into various types of cover (grass, forests, bare ground, etc.), each of which has unique reflecting properties. However, even within the same type of cover, reflections can vary due to differences in the composition and structure of the surface. In this case, the reflectivity of the earth with heterogeneities is a random variable with an exponential correlation function. The correlation radius affects the requirements for model discreteness, that is, the size of the cells into which the surface is divided during modeling. This work considers the effect of the discreteness of the digital terrain map on the spread of the power of the signal reflected from such areas. Statistical and spectral characteristics of the reflected signals are considered. The presented general relations are specified for commonly used approximations of the radiation pattern and probing pulses. The resulting relations can be used in simulating reflections from the earth’s surface for radar operation modeling.

articleTitle: Peak Intensity at a Nonlinear Focus during Propagation of High-Power Laser Radiation in an Optical Medium
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The nonlinear focus formation during propagation of high-power laser radiation of ultrashort duration in the mode of self-focusing on an optical medium is studied. Particular attention is given to the propagation of a femtosecond laser pulse in air from the point of beginning the collapse arrest to the nonlinear focus. The theory of nonlinear Schrödinger equation solving in a Kerr-plasma medium with nonlinear absorption within the amplitude-phase approach is used to obtain an expression for the peak intensity in the focus. As a result, it is shown that the intensity collapse arrests in the interval from the point of the collapse arrest beginning to the nonlinear focus, and the peak radiation intensity doubles. In this case the collapse arrest criterion is determined in the approximation of the nonlinear Schrödinger equation. This criterion considers the nonlinear characteristics of various optical media in the case of propagation of high-power ultrashort laser radiation.

articleTitle: Multi-stage Fuzzy Controller for a Multi-motor System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Due to the increasing complexity of the requirements for automated control systems in various industries, an extremely important problem arises in connection with the creation of such systems. To date, it is impossible to provide high quality control of a complex object without a control system based on a fairly accurate mathematical model. Such a model should take into account most of the available approaches to the formalisation of regulatory objects, namely: improving the accuracy and quality of the mathematical description, the possibility of working with qualitative characteristics based on the formed system of restrictions and assumptions. Some directions of expansion of intellectual capabilities are both structural solutions (implementation of nesting) and parametric (modelling of spatial form membership functions). A multi-stage fuzzy control system for a multi-motor object consisting of DC motors is considered in the paper. The output characteristics of the drive, the input and the output systems are given. The working mechanism and model of the fuzzy controller are described. Knowledge bases and a functional diagram of a fuzzy controller are presented. A comparison of the considered system with the classical controller is made.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Optimal Precoder Design for Multiuser MISO Channel with Delayed CSI
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper the numerical based investigation of the impact of delayed channel state information due to user movement and caused channel aging on the performance of multiuser precoder in downlink wireless system is presented. The time variant CSI is obtained by the least square channel estimation based on pilot symbols. We consider codebook Type 2 precoding algorithm and numerical optimization based solution of calculating precoder vectors maximizing the sum rate of multiuser system. For system evaluation the QuaDRiGA channel model is used giving the channel realization corresponding for moving users. For comparison of performances of multiuser codebook Type 2 precoding and optimization based precoding the empirical distribution of the sum rate of multiuser system is used. The optimization problem is numerically solved using the open software implementations of convex optimization methods. The results show that the performance gain of precoder based on SOCP is more significant than Type 2 CSI precoder in scenario with larger speed of moving users.

articleTitle: Elements of Qualitative Preparation of Teaching Materials in an Online Learning Environment at the University Level
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: During the pandemic it has become possible to see the positive aspects of online education and use them to its fullest. As you know, any training course consists of several parts, such as: lectures and practical classes, independent work and assessment of acquired knowledge. Transition to online education requires careful transformation and realization of all these parts in new conditions. The problems and possible solutions appeared during transition to online education in the Inha University in Tashkent are discussed in the paper. In particular, we present several accessible ways to organize online lectures, independent work of students, online exams and other assignments. In addition, we reveal some ideas to grade the students during distant learning. Finally, we compare the results of traditional and online learning using an example of particular mathematical courses. This comparison showed that the level of education in the Inha University in Tashkent during online period maintained the same as during traditional period.

articleTitle: Converting the HFCT Voltage Output Signal to Apparent Charge of Partial Discharge
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The scale factor k is used to calculate the apparent charge of a partial discharge. It is used to convert the voltage signal from the measuring sensor output to the apparent charge value. This requires calibration of the measuring circuit. The signal of these devices is standardized and is usually low-powered and jammed by external interference. The calibration signal is broadband and during calibration these harmonics may fall into the resonant frequencies of the test system or be attenuated, resulting in an incorrect estimate of the apparent charge of the partial discharge. This paper describes a method for calculating the apparent charge of a partial discharge using the transfer function of a measurement sensor. The transfer function of the sensor for measuring partial discharges was measured. Then the partial discharge current of the high frequency current transformer in the primary circuit is calculated from the output voltage of the sensor. The apparent charge of the partial discharge can then be calculated.

articleTitle: Simulation of One-way Traffic Flow Using the System Dynamics Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problems of simulation traffic flows arise in various areas of human activity, for example in the road industry and in the design of production lines. Various approaches are used to simulate traffic flows. One of them is the use of system dynamics methods. The use of system dynamics makes it possible to model traffic flow as a continuous system of ordinary differential equations. The presence of control algorithms in the model when using the system dynamics method leads to the appearance of additional nonlinearities with discontinuities of the first type. This leads to the fact that in certain regimes the system of differential equations becomes stiff. To solve these systems of equations, various integration methods can be used, including methods with a variable integration step. The use of methods with a variable integration step in combination with event detection methods makes it possible to perform calculations with a step significantly larger than when using discrete traffic flow models.

articleTitle: Switched-Capacitor Low-Pass Filter with Pole Frequency Tuning at Constant Frequency of Switching
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The circuitry of a switched-capacitor low-pass filter (SCF) is considered, in which it is possible to tune the pole frequency without changing the capacitances of the switched capacitors, for example, by selecting them of the same kind. To study the suggested SCF circuit, the analysis in the time domain was used, and the obtained characteristics of the SCF were further compared with the characteristics of a generalized second-order analog filter. It is shown that the parameters implemented by the suggested filter depend not only on the capacitance values of the switched capacitors, but also on the ratio of the resistances of two additional resistors. Moreover, the SCF pole frequency is determined by the switching frequency of the keys, the ratios of the capacitances of the switched capacitors, as well as the ratio of the resistances of additional resistors. Due to the goal-oriented selection of the resistances of these resistors, it is possible to lower the SCF pole frequency at constant and identical values of the capacitances of the switched capacitors.

articleTitle: The Novel Passive Devices for S-Band Satellite Amplifiers on a Base of the Nolen Beam-Forming Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper contains the S-band 3- and 4-channel microwave devices consisting of the printed hybrid junctions. These networks are realized through the printed technology. Contrary to well-known multi-port amplifiers (MPA) on a base of Butler beam-forming matrices, the proposed architecture uses the Nolen beam-forming networks those offer the possibility to realize any of the amplifying channels. Starting from the previously realized dividing-summating networks, the authors believe that the any channels may be realized. Additionally, the phase differences between channels are also acceptable. This architecture was implemented to energize the S-band cosmic dipole antenna system. Before the concretion of such the radiator, the detailed design algorithm related to the corresponding dividing-summating architecture is needed. Also, the simulation-derived results on a base of the FORTRAN-oriented computer are described. The depicted summating architectures are the good candidates for the printed satellite networks.

articleTitle: A HUD-based Platform for Environmental Sensing and Measurement: Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents a Heads-up Display (HUD) based Platform for Environmental Sensing and Measurement (PESM), which can provide the user with more environmental parameters (such as short distance measuring, luminance, temperature and environment radiation) while keeping the user aware of the situation ahead. The main contributions of this paper are(1)The design principles and components of the platform are introduced in detail;(2)The design and implementation method of the Power Management Unit (PMU) for the PESM is proposed by using comparison and experiment methods. The DC-DC and LDO hybrid scheme shows its good adaptability;(3)The platform’s performance in actual application scenarios (including road, park riverside and mountain) in daytime and night is demonstrated by combining it with the authentic scene.The paper also discusses some challenges and solutions encountered during the design and testing, as well as the future improvement of the PESM. Finally, the author provides the conclusion of the PESM project.

articleTitle: Technique for Evaluating the Effectiveness of the Information Security Department
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article proposes a technique that establishes the procedure for evaluating the level of efficiency of the information security department (an employee performing information security functions). The technique uses performance evaluation criteria based on the apparatus of fuzzy logic, the composition of fuzzy relations. The technique describes the procedure for evaluating the effectiveness of the information security department (information security officer) during audits in the area of "Organization and state of work on information protection", self-assessment of the effectiveness of work. The method of assessing the level of efficiency consists in presenting with the help of a set of measurements (both at the quantitative and qualitative level) the features collected to build a classification of the effectiveness of the information security department (information security officer). Based on a set of measurements of signs, the decision-maker must determine (classify) the effectiveness of work using the criteria for assessing the quality of their work. In the future, the methodology can be expanded for additional purposes of predicting the level of security of informatization objects.

Author Keywords: evaluation of the level of work efficiency

articleTitle: Optimal Distribution Network Reconfiguration Considering Fixed and Time-Varying Commerical Load Demand
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents a new approach to solving the network reconfiguration (NR) problem of the distribution network (DN) with fixed and time-varying load demand using the dung beetle optimization algorithm (DBOA). This algorithm is an optimization technique for the behaviors of dung beetles, including ball-rolling, dancing, foraging, stealing, and reproducing. NR with time-varying load demand is a combinatorial problem that is difficult to solve. To minimize power loss and energy loss costs, it is necessary to identify the optimal radial structure for a DN. In order to evaluate the feasibility of the structure and to count the real power losses and its costs for different levels of demand, a DBOA with backward-forward load flow has been used for radial DN. MATLAB 2021b software has been used to implement the technique, and IEEE 33 bus test DN has been used to evaluate it. To validate and prove the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, the obtained results were compared to those obtained in the literature.

articleTitle: Input-output Module of Control Software for Servo Hydraulic Drives with Hydrostatic Guides
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents control software for servo hydraulic drives (SHD) with hydrostatic guides (HG). The control software is used to organize the operation of SHD with HG in a test bench structure. The functions of the software in question are control, adjustment and diagnostics of parameters of SHD with HG. Adjustment of the frequency of influence on the controlled object occurs by transfer of effort from the pumping unit through a specialized platform by processing signals coming from the control system. SHD with HG used in the diagnostic stand has a service life of up to 100 million cycles by operating loads. This performance is achieved through the use of HG in the design of SHD. Focused on ensuring the automated operation of SHD with HG, the architecture of the control software complex allows you to monitor the status of equipment using digital data transfer protocols, set all the necessary equipment parameters, and organizes centralized storage and replication of settings of SHD with HG. As a result of data reception modeling and transmission between SHD with HG installation and the software package, the operability of the control software was checked.

articleTitle: Separable Fuzzy Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: One of the directions of application of the theory of fuzzy models is model-theoretic formalization of quantum computing. The central concept of quantum computing is quantum entanglement. A quantum system is considered to be unentangled or separable if the results of measurements of some elements of the system do not depend on measurements of other elements.Fuzzy Model can be considered as a generalization of quantum system. The paper deals with the generalization of the separability property of the system to the case of arbitrary Fuzzy Model. The definition of Fuzzy Separable Model is given. It is proved that under given initial conditions (atomic diagram of the model) there exists not more than one Separable Fuzzy Model. The criterion, which the distribution function of a fuzzy model must have in order for this model to become separable, is described. The notion of the rank of the Separable Model is introduced, which can be regarded as a measure of entropy of fuzziness of the Separable Model.

articleTitle: Method for Accelerated Numerical Solution of Nonlinear Differential Equations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A method for the accelerated solution of nonlinear differential equations is proposed. It is based on various combinations of simple averaging of function values at neighboring nodes and known computational schemes. Also, the proposed method retains the ability of explicit circuits to parallelize computations. As a rule, simple averaging is calculated faster than calculating the function value using explicit schemes. This paper shows the application of the method in combination with some well-known explicit schemes to the solution of non-linear partial differential equations: the Burgers equation and the Korteweg-de Vries equation. Averaging is applied to the KDV equation with alternation only over time layers, and to the Burgers equation through alternation of averaging in each time layer. The paper provides examples of calculation by the proposed method, which shows that it is possible to reduce the calculation time by half relative to classic methods using only an explicit finite-difference scheme.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of the Thermographic Image of the Lower Limbs Varicose Disease in Humans
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Chronic cardiovascular diseases are classified as "diseases of civilization", which the World Health Organization identifies as a separate group. Lower limb varicose veins develop due to pathological changes in the vascular wall of the venous bed and are accompanied by irreversible changes in the surrounding tissues and body systems, an increase in temperature at the site of inflammation. Detection of visually unobservable pathological veins is possible with the help of thermography. It allows you to reconstruct the deformed venous bed, as well as to build thermographic profiles, with which it is possible to compare data from the preoperative examination with the data from postoperative examinations. In this work, mathematical modeling of the distribution of heat over the surface of the human lower leg in the presence of varicose disease and comparison of the obtained distribution with the results of real thermography were performed. The simulation results are presented in the form of thermograms of the lower leg surface in normal and pathological conditions and thermographic profiles. The constructed mathematical model of thermal processes occurring in the lower limbs varicose disease in humans is in sufficient agreement with the actually observed thermographic picture. This is the first time such mathematical modeling of varicose veins has been performed.

articleTitle: Retrieving Rock Conductivity Model During Well Drilling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, the algorithms for the numerical determination of electrophysical properties of drilling mud invasion zones in the formation during well drilling are presented. This problem is considered as one of the stages in solving the multiphysics problem of the electromagnetic monitoring of the drilling fluid invasion. The purpose of the study is to develop a technique to obtain the effective values of electrical conductivity based on a set of numerically determined saturations for fluid components. The electrical characteristics of fluid components in separate, formation layers' porosity and the rock matrix properties are known. These effective electrical conductivities are then used in numerical modeling of the electromagnetic signal responses in the borehole to identify the colmatation processes in the near-well bottom zone. The finite element method and its non-conformal modifications are used in all steps of numerical simulation both for fluid dynamics and electromagnetic problems, including the Discontinuous Galerkin method and the heterogeneous multiscale finite element method.

articleTitle: Factors Affecting the Process of Microwave Sterilization of Medical Instruments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The possibility of using electromagnetic microwave radiation for the disinfection of metal instruments is an important area in science. In addition, the issue of sterilization of medical instruments is important from a practical point of view. An important part of the research of the operation of a microwave sterilizer is the assessment of factors that affect the efficiency of the processing process. During experiments on the sterilization of medical instruments, factors were found that affect the effectiveness of the processing process. Accounting for these factors will improve the technology of microwave sterilization and develop an optimal algorithm for the sterilization process. Most of the currently known methods of sterilization are based on the principles of thermal action, as a result of which they require a rather long treatment period (at least an hour). Such devices are not mobile, large in size and weight. The process of thermal sterilization requires a multi-stage preparation of instruments before placing them in a sterilization unit, which complicates the technical process of the disinfection procedure. The advantage of the experimental setup, which is considered in this paper, is the simplicity of the sterilization process. No additional processing of medical instruments is required before they are immersed in a sterilizer. After removing their sterilizer, the instruments can be used immediately. These facts will make it possible to use the microwave sterilizer in the future not only in medical hospitals, but also in mobile medical care centers. The objective of this work is to improve the technique microwave sterilization, taking into account the following factors: processing time, power of microwave oscillator, number of instruments, their location, water level in the operating cuvette. In addition, it is important to assess the temperature of the instruments during the sterilization process and the possible damage to the instrument surface.

articleTitle: Methodology of Circuit Modeling of Charge-Sensitive Amplifiers Based on Wide-Band-Gap (GaAs, GaN) D-FETs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Semiconductors with wide bandgap are the main candidates in the foreseeable future for overcoming fundamental limitations of conventional electronics in high-temperature applications. The paper considers a step-by-step technique for selecting parameters and operating modes of GaAs, GaN charge-sensitive amplifiers based on depletion mode type Field Effect Transistor (D-FET), which provides minimum current consumption, low noise and high speed performance. Realization of the D-FETs on wide-band-gap semiconductors, for example, GaAs, GaN, allows to create microcircuits that retain their performance in hash operating conditions, including under the influence of penetrating radiation of high level and temperatures above 200°C. Modern technological routes of manufacturing of wide-gap microcircuits, usually, do not allow to form on one crystal active elements of several types and high-resistors, which complicates circuit synthesis of microcircuits of this class. The article gives recommendations on the development of design rules for analog microcircuits (operational and multidifferential operational amplifiers, transimpedance and charge-sensitive amplifiers, current conveyors, etc.) for the tasks of signal processing of sensors of physical quantities in the range of high temperatures (+150°C … +500°C). Circuit modeling using the proposed methodology allowed to develop a charge-sensitive amplifier that contains only GaAs DpHEMTs (double channel pseudomorphic high electron mobility transistor) of two designs and 8 kOhm resistor and has a power consumption of less than 55 mW, a rise time of less than 56 ns, the equivalent noise charge - less than 600 electrons at signal source capacitance of 100 pF.

articleTitle: Reference Generators for Medical Electronic Devices to the Evaluating of Biological Objects Electrophysical Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: When designing and developing technical diagnostic tools, it is necessary to take into account the peculiarities of their interaction with the study object.
