The non-linear dependence of biological objects electrophysical parameters on the applied electrical energy leads to the uncertainties of the introduced perturbation. As a result, poor reproducibility of biological objects measuring the electrophysical parameters results is observed. For this reason, technical means of measurement in the assessment of electrophysical parameters of biological objects have not been widely used. The study is aimed at developing systems, methods and algorithms that can be used to assess the biological objects electrical parameters in medical electronic devices. A feature of these devices is the impact on the load in a given mode. The use of such technical measuring instruments will improve the metrological parameters of measuring systems, increase the reproducibility and reliability of the results obtained. The correct interpretation of the obtained results allows you obtaining qualitatively new measuring information in medicine. The obtained results of the study contribute to the development of means for diagnosing the body condition and physiotherapeutic effects.

articleTitle: Methodology for Detecting Attacks in the Context of Destructive Influences
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Recently, the number of incidents involving unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has increased markedly, which emphasizes the urgent need to improve the level of their security. Given the large number of heterogeneous UAV models on the market, there is an urgent need to unify approaches to data collection and analysis to ensure effective attack detection. A new model for constructing the attack vector of the system is proposed. This model, based on an ontological approach, reflects the relationship between the cyber-physical parameters of the UAV, the attacker's impact, and the consequence. The model allowed identifying unique sets of parameter groups that are associated with specific attacks and other types of destructive impact. In this way, groups of parameters can be identified and the degree to which they are affected by the attack can be assessed. This allows identifying anomalies and preventing possible attacks at an early stage. The developed algorithm is a universal tool that is able to analyze a large amount of heterogeneous data in real time, highlighting anomalous patterns of system behavior and thus significantly reducing the risks of malicious factors. The experimental part demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed approach in practice, confirming its high performance under various models of UAV operation.

articleTitle: Organization of Monitoring in the Example of LMS Moodle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This study analyzes the experience of the Urgench branch of the Tashkent University of Information Technologies named after Muhammad al-Khorezmi in the field of ensuring the quality of e-learning. The main emphasis was placed on assessing the quality indicators of educational materials and support for the educational process. The article explored the possibilities of managing these indicators using the MOODLE educational process management system, as well as basic tools and special services developed in the Urgench branch. The study authors analyzed data on the number of students registered in courses, their activity, and other parameters associated with educational units. Data on the structure and content of e-learning courses, as well as settings that may influence the quality of training, were reviewed. The study included an analysis of the activity of both students and teachers on the MOODLE platform. Assess intermediate student learning outcomes, such as grades on assignments, tests, and exams. Analyzing user support requests helped us understand user problems and needs and take appropriate action. The authors of the study developed a methodology for processing and analyzing the data obtained, which made it possible to make management decisions based on specific indicators of the quality of education. This analysis can improve the efficiency and effectiveness of e-learning at the university and increase the satisfaction of students and teachers.

articleTitle: Prediction of Defect Formation Process in Lithium Fluoride Using Nonlinear Regression Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed to use nonlinear regression analysis to study the regularities of defect formation in LiF. At different stages of exposure, the development of defects, colloids and voids on the surface of the lithium fluoride nanocrystals was investigated by method total current spectroscopy. Electronic interaction with a lithium fluoride film of during the thermal annealing process that followed the formation of the vacancies, colloids, voids and defects that had been created by electron (e) irradiation were also subjected to thermal treatment. Based on the analysis of experimental research, it was shown that the formation of defects in lithium fluoride depends on temperature, irradiation, and impurity concentration. The physical regularity of the process of aggregation and desorption was determined, and a mathematical model of the temperature dependence of the concentration (voids intensity) of the V-center peak was obtained by the method of nonlinear regression analysis. The obtained regression model predicts the change in concentration depending on the temperature of the V-center peak at negative temperatures. The results obtained can be used to develop new methods for controlling defects in LiF and improving its properties.

articleTitle: Choosing a Policy of Power Equipment Repairs Management. Methodology of Assessment and Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The choice and implementation of the appropriate policy are largely determines the efficiency of business processes in the management of production assets of an energy service company. The actualization of the company's choice of the right policy occurred with the approval of new rules for the organization of electric power facilities operation. The problem of choice is aggravated by an approach based on a combination of production experience and expert opinions, which in some cases are poorly coordinated. The authors have developed a methodological basis for choosing one of the alternative maintenance and repair policies of power equipment "by periodicity, operating time" or "by technical condition", taking into accounts the strategic priorities of the owner company. The presented methodology serves as a universal tool for comparing alternatives according to a single set of criteria using the principles of a risk-based approach. The paper considers a generalized algorithm for solving the complex problem of ensuring a reliable power supply to industrial consumers for each of the alternative policies. The main theoretical positions are illustrated by the example of a typical oil production power supply system using real data and operational constraints. The obtained results confirm the possibilities of the methodology for the reasonable choice of the most effective maintenance and repair policy of equipment and its readiness for practical application in the conditions of power facilities real operation.

articleTitle: Classification of Borrowers Using an Immune Model of Artificial Intelligence in Credit Scoring Tasks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: for financial organizations, one of the most important tasks is credit scoring - assessing the credit and solvency of potential customers. Classifying clients into risk groups allows banks to make decisions on whether to issue a loan. An approach is proposed that allows you to use any type of features and achieve high accuracy of predictions on various data sets. The study used open data sets most commonly used by developers of credit scoring systems: Credit Risk Analysis, Credit Risk Dataset and German Credit Data. To classify clients by credit risk level, an artificial immune network model and stable algorithms for its training were used. Existing open data sets are limited in size, and the immune model has improved classification accuracy on small training sets. The following indicators of errors in classifying clients by credit risk level were achieved depending on data sets: Credit Risk Dataset: 0.109; Credit Risk Analysis: 0.031; German Credit Data: 0.18. In comparison with the analyzed publications, the size of the training sample was reduced by 2.5-11 times, while the obtained reliability indicators correspond to the world level or exceed the highest previously achieved.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Tool for Extracting Uzbek Syllables
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The accurate syllabification of words plays a vital role in various Natural Language Processing applications. Syllabification is a versatile linguistic tool with applications in linguistic research, language technology, education, and various fields where understanding and processing language is essential. In this paper, we present a comprehensive approach to syllabification for the Uzbek language, including rule-based techniques and machine learning algorithms. Our rule-based approach utilizes advanced methods for dividing words into syllables, generating hyphenations for line breaks and count of syllables. Additionally, we collected a dataset for evaluating and training using machine learning algorithms comprising word-syllable mappings, hyphenations, and syllable counts to predict syllable counts as well as for the evaluation of the proposed model. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of both approaches in achieving accurate syllabification. The results of our experiments show that both approaches achieved a high level of accuracy, exceeding 99%. This study provides valuable insights and recommendations for future research on syllabification and related areas in not only the Uzbek language itself, but also in other closely-related Turkic languages with low-resource factor.

articleTitle: Computational-Heuristic Algorithm for Tomographic Solution of Industrial Flaw Detection Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the results of the development and study of the application of a computational heuristic algorithm for industrial tomography based on the use of a reference sample of an industrial product. Thus, based on a priori information about the reference sample of the product, it is possible to build a local tomographic reconstruction from limited initial data due to the selective sensitivity of the object under study to probing radiation. This approach is consistent with the principle of "strong methods", which has recently proven itself well in the field of artificial intelligence. The results obtained form the basis for the development of an appropriate information and computing technology, including algorithmic and software for computer processing and interpretation of measurement data. The paper also presents the designed architecture and software prototype with a graphical interface that implements local tomographic reconstruction based on the proposed algorithms. The presented experimental results testify to the efficiency and speed of the proposed algorithm in comparison with the classical algorithm of computed tomography. The proposed algorithm also makes it possible to detect defects of small thickness, when the classical tomography algorithm cannot cope. From an applied point of view, this study is of interest in the heuristic search for a defect in a product model and allows us to conclude that it is promising in the field of industrial flaw detection.

articleTitle: The Process of Primary Frequency Control of the Power Systems Investigation Using Modeling Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: General primary frequency regulation (GPFR) is employed within the power system to limit frequency variation deviations from a reference value in positive and negative directions, ensuring safe power object operations and reducing the prevalence of power outages. Requirements for primary frequency regulation are presented in normative documents. They regulate the statism of regulation (from 4 to 6%) and the minimum time of increase/decrease of power plant capacity. However, in practice, undamped frequency fluctuations and unnecessary consumer and generation outages occur in frequency regulation in power systems in some emergency disturbances. In 2020, the Norilsk-Taimyr power system experienced an accident with an unbalanced active power of 40 MW. The frequency was regulated by two power plants - Ust-Khantai and Kurey HPPs. Low-frequency oscillations occurred for 27 seconds. Only with a statism of 25 percent, which does not match the standards, a stable frequency control could be achieved. This case highlights the problem of suboptimal GPFC laws in frequency control of multiple power plants. This paper presents the modelling of the power system in MATLAB environment to investigate the transients in GPFC. Based on the data obtained, the shortcomings of the control laws used can be noted and criteria for the creation of modernized control algorithms can be put forward.

articleTitle: A Technique for Measuring the Frequency of Electrical Power Network Based on Spectral Analysis with Application of Henning Window
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Signal frequency is one of the most important parameters of electrical networks. To measure the frequency of an electrical network, methods based on magnitude spectrum analysis are very popular. The main factor reducing the accuracy of these methods is the effect of spectrum leakage. The article discusses two main approaches for measuring frequency in the frequency domain while reducing the influence of spectrum leakage, based on the application of window functions and arithmetic spectrum transformation (the case of calculating samples of the modified spectrum from the three closest samples of the original spectrum is considered). The accuracy of existing techniques is compared for the case of a sinusoidal input signal, a polyharmonic input signal (the case of two harmonics is considered) and a sinusoidal input signal distorted by random noise (the ratio of signal power to noise power equal to 20 dB is considered). The parameters of the simulated input influences are selected in accordance with the current regulatory documents. For the case of reducing the effect of spectrum leakage by using window functions, a rectangular window and a Henning window are considered for the case of performing two-point and three-point approximation of amplitude spectrum samples. The paper discusses a new approach based on the application of the Henning window and approximation by two points and subsequent arithmetic transformation of the spectrum. By means of simulation modeling, an analytical relation was obtained that allows to determine the frequency value from the largest two spectrum samples after performing an arithmetic transformation. The accuracy characteristics of the proposed and existing approaches are compared for the case of a sinusoidal input signal, a polyharmonic input signal, and a sinusoidal input signal distorted by random noise. It has been proven that the proposed approach is significantly more efficient for the case of both sinusoidal and polyharmonic signals under conditions of spectrum leakage. Simulation mathematical modeling was carried out in the Matlab environment.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of C/OCGA Sparse Horn Antenna Structures at Different Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Currently, the research and development of novel antennas that offer reduced mass and size compared to conventional antennas while maintaining high performance is a significant objective. Particularly in wideband applications, meeting complex requirements to achieve these goals is crucial. The optimal current grid approximation and its modified version for wire-grid antennas show great promise in generating sparse antennas with controlled design integrity characteristics while minimizing mass. These approximation approaches offer the advantage of reducing resource requirements and enabling precise control of antenna characteristics in future modeling. However, it is essential to consider that as the frequency changes, the current distribution across the grid wires varies, resulting in different sparse structures after applying these approaches. This paper focuses on thoroughly investigating and comparing the performance of the obtained sparse antenna structures within the antenna operating frequency band. The study applies these approaches to a model of a 3D printed perforated horn antenna designed for X-band operation. Sparse structures obtained at three key frequencies in the antenna bandwidth (8, 10, and 12 GHz), are used. The paper extensively discusses the advantages and limitations of these sparse structures, providing valuable recommendations for selecting the most appropriate one for specific applications. By understanding the performance differences of sparse antennas at different operating frequencies, this research aims to enhance the efficiency of sparse antenna design.

articleTitle: On the Effect of Sudden Failures and Control Errors of the First Kind on the Degradation Cycle of an Optical Cable
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The failure of the access network fiber leads to failures on a variety of channels and the loss of a huge amount of information. Therefore, increased requirements are placed on the reliability of fiber-optic lines. Failures of an optical cable can be divided into sudden and degradation failures that occur due to the aging of the optical fiber during operation. To determine the presence of fiber failures, a technical condition monitoring system can be used, that performs periodic monitoring, as a result sudden failures are detected. At the same time, false alarms are possible when the system records a failure in its actual absence, i.e. control errors occur. The article discusses the impact of sudden failures and control errors of the first kind on the optical cable reliability in the conditions of its degradation during operation. To solve this problem, a Markov reliability model was developed. On its basis equations for calculating the unavailability factor, the average recovery time on the degradation cycle, and the average degradation cycle duration of an optical cable under periodic monitoring conditions were obtained. It is shown that the unavailability factor of the optical cable is influenced by the duration of the intervals between checks and control errors of the first kind. The optical cable reliability model presented in the article can be useful for predicting the operating time of an optical cable.

articleTitle: High–Frequency Transformer Development for Compact Dual Active Bridge Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents a methodology for designing high–frequency transformers operating at 20 kHz made for operation in dual active bridge converter with a voltage setup of 600V/3x100V. The paper begins by explaining the calculation process for the transformer's design, focusing on crucial aspects such as leakage and magnetizing inductances. Specific techniques for the transformer winding process are discussed, ensuring accuracy and efficiency. Furthermore, the paper analyzed into calculating the parameters that make up the transformer's equivalent circuit, offering insights into its electrical characteristics. It also explores the impact of transformer leakage inductance on the converter's active power performance. To ensure the transformer's robust thermal performance, a thorough thermal analysis using Ansys software is conducted by considering various cooling methods. Finally, the construction details of the transformer, bridging the gap between theoretical design and practical realization are presented. The research concludes with the development of the final transformer construction, harmonizing the theoretical design with practical realization. This study contributes to the field of high–frequency transformer design and highlights the significance of design considerations, particularly in applications where compact and highly efficient power conversion solutions are required.

articleTitle: Automated Methods for Modeling Thinking and Reasoning Based on the Partial Model Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of modeling natural human intelligence in order to develop explainable artificial intelligence. The problems of modeling thinking, reasoning, consciousness, reflection and self-reflection are solved. For this purpose, formalization of images of perception and thinking, representations and concepts is proposed. The formal presentation of reasoning and consciousness is based on I.P. Pavlov’s studies of the first and second human signaling systems. To solve problems of explainable artificial intelligence, the integration of deep machine learning technologies and logical-semantic methods is proposed. At the same time, neural networks must implement perception, and logical-semantic methods must model reasoning. The mathematical basis of the developed methods for modeling thinking, reasoning and consciousness is the theory of partial models. Embeddings and ontological homomorphisms of partial models are used. For syntactic formal representation we use fragments of atomic diagrams.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of Power Grid Frequency Measurements Using a Method Based on the Analysis of Phase Increment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Currently, it is important to be capable to quickly and precisely measure the frequency of voltage of the power grid. This is necessary for the management and control of the electrical network, as well as for the correct operation of a number of electrical devices. You can see a lot of methods for measuring the frequency of digital signals, one of them is an approach based on the analysis of phase increment. The purpose of this work is to consider possible ways to increase the accuracy of this method and evaluate their effectiveness. The following possible ways to improve the accuracy of measuring the frequency of the electrical network when using a technique based on the analysis of phase increment are described in the paper: the use of digital filtration; a method based on the calculation of the derivative of the straight line (LDCM) connecting the samples spaced for the period of the input signal; the use of the method of least squares (LSM). The effectiveness of the methods is evaluated by simulation mathematical modeling. In this paper, it is assumed that the mains voltage was converted to digital format by using an ideal ADC, the quantization error of which is not taken into account in this problem. It is also supposed that the sampling frequency is many times higher than the maximum value of the frequency range of the signal. Modeling is carried out by using the Matlab package. In paper it is established that from the point of view of accuracy, the most effective modification is the use of the FIR filter, from the perspective of consideration of the measurement time - LDCM. The application of LSM allows to implement to measure the frequency with higher accuracy than the Shifting Window Average Method. At the same time, the use of LSM requires much more computing power than all the methods listed above, which makes its use ineffective in this case.

articleTitle: Development of an Intelligent Assistant for Document Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is devoted to development of mathematical methods for formal modeling of business processes and their use in creation of intelligent assistants. These methods are based on the use of ontologies, partial models and their ontological homomorphisms. Partial model theory is applied for the organization and structuring of the document automation. Development of intelligent assistant which can automate the process of creating documents is one of the tasks. As example we consider document automation at the university department. To achieve this goal an ontological model was developed and templates for various types of documents were created. The flexibility of the ontological model makes it easy to adapt the document process to changing regulations. Special attention is paid to the problem of finding and eliminating contradictions in documents. An approach based on neural networks and logic semantic methods was considered to automate the process of identifying and resolving contradictions in texts.

articleTitle: Module for Collecting, Processing and Aggregating Data of the Transaction Analysis System on the Bitcoin Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents the study and systematization of the subject area, as well as the implementation of the module for automating the collection, processing and aggregation of transaction data and Bitcoin network participants from different sources. The novelty of the work lies in the proposal of the author's approach to the classification of information sources, as well as in introducing an additional list of entity types (categories of Bitcoin network participants), which, unlike existing solutions, will increase the reliability of extracted data from various sources about participants and transactions of the Bitcoin network. The implementation of the module, which is part of the general transaction analysis system, in the form of database diagrams, classes and sequences is considered. The results of this work provide an opportunity to develop a high-quality dataset with its subsequent use in classification and clustering algorithms to improve the efficiency of the identification process of funds in the Bitcoin network obtained illegally.

articleTitle: Estimates of the Distortion Contribution From the Reference Sensor to the Calibration Results of the Built-in Angle Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper proposes an alternative approach that provides high-precision calibration of built-in angle encoders included in angle measuring setups using available control means. The approach is based on the complex use of modern variants of realization of cross- and autocalibration methods. It is shown that algorithmically the procedure of cross-calibration of one scale with the help of another is identical to the procedure of autocalibration in multi-headed angle encoders whose readout heads are localized according to the prescriptions of basic methods, including the Watanabe multi-combination method. It is shown that the uncertainty of calibration of angle sensors of the built–in type can be reduced from the initial level of ±1.3ʺ, which characterizes the instrumental error of manufacturing the scale of the controlling sensor, to the required level, estimated as ±0.02ʺ, in just 15 comparisons of all scale bars of the controlled sensor with all scale bars of the four-headed controlling sensor, taken as a standard of comparison.

articleTitle: Clock Network Design Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Clock network makes a large contribution to overall power consumption due to the large number of interconnects and frequent switching of clock elements. Developing a reliable, high-performance, low-power clock network is becoming increasingly difficult as technological design standards become increasingly tighter. To ensure the reliability of the circuit, it is necessary to use restrictions that affect the complexity of timing closure. The structure of this article is as follows: in Chapter II, a literary analysis of dissertations on the topic of clock network design was carried out and the problems that were considered in them were presented in Chapter III definitions of clock network design indicators were given, which most often become objects of scientific research; Chapter IV presents methods used in clock network design, such as: 1) Clock gating; 2) Clustering; 4) Changing the size of library elements; 6) Use of various clock network architectures: h-tree, clock mesh, clock tree with cross links tree, clock tree, clock spine; 7) Hybrid methods. The result provides the research community with a brief overview of the challenges associated with clock network design techniques and presents the overall picture of clock network design to guide future research in the right direction.

articleTitle: Combining Lexicons and Neural Networks for Targeted Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we consider the targeted sentiment analysis problem for the Russian language. We compared several machine learning approaches based on transformer architecture: BERT, RuBERT, RuRoberta. The main focus of our studies was directed to the use of additional sources of knowledge stored in sentiment lexicons. Two Russian sentiment lexicons: RuSentiLex and RuSentiFrames were involved in our study. We use the lexicons in two different ways. The first technique uses the RuSentiLex for automatic labeling of additional text data to enhance training dataset. Two variants of the lexicon-based annotated texts were obtained: general and domain-specific collections. Another technique creates embeddings for word labels in sentiment lexicons and, in such a way, integrate the lexicon knowledge into the whole process of neural network training. The combination of two Russian vocabularies and the GRU-TSC architecture achieved state-of-the-art results on five evaluation datasets.

articleTitle: Fluctuation Dielectric Fourier Spectrometer for Estimation of Blood Cellular Components
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Α qualitative method for evaluating the condition of blood components using the dielectric properties of a blood sample is presented in the paper. The proposed scheme, unique software implementation, and design of a Fourier fluctuation dielectric spectrometer (FDFS) are described. With its assistance, it is possible to acquire the statistical distribution of blood components by membrane state in a short time frame of 10-15 seconds, enabling the qualitative evaluation of the entire circulatory system's functionality. An important property of the developed device is a small amount of the investigated blood sample (50-80µl). The author's experiments to assess the functional state of patients with ischemic heart disease and to examine the impact of Ehrlich ascites carcinoma on the blood of laboratory mice serve as examples of this study. It has been demonstrated that the proposed FRFS provides a speedy evaluation of changes in blood parameters during disease progression, as well as an elucidation of the dynamics of the tumor process in experimental animals.

articleTitle: Influence of Physiological Determinants on Acoustic Parameters of Forced Expiratory Tracheal Sounds
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Significant disadvantages of standard lung auscultation are subjectivity and exclusively qualitative assessment of the measurement results. Developments in digital signal processing of breath sounds have obvious potential to turn auscultation into a scientific method. Forced expiratory (FE) tracheal noise analysis has proven to be a useful tool for detecting bronchial obstruction. The developed processing method with splitting the signal into bands of 200 Hz in the range of 200-2000 Hz has the potential to increase the efficiency of acoustic diagnostics. However, the influence of physiological determinants on the spectra of respiratory noises has not been studied enough. The purpose of this work is to study the relationships between the spectral characteristics of FE wheezes and 200 Hz frequency-time parameters of FE noises with age and anthropometry. As well as assess gender differences in these parameters. On a sample of 41 healthy subjects of both sexes aged from 20 to 59 years, significant correlations of acoustic parameters with age and anthropometry were found. But the strength of these relationships was very moderate. However, the acoustic characteristics of the tracheal noises differed between men and women. Peak frequencies of mid-frequency wheezes were higher in women, and their maximum amplitudes were higher in men. Gender differences were found in both time and frequency domains. In women, the proportion of the higher frequency band (600-800 Hz) of the mid-frequency range prevailed, while in men the proportion of the band 200-400 Hz. This should be taken into account when developing approaches to normalizing acoustic parameters.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Distribution Network with DG Units and ESS Considering Costs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the application of the artificial ecosystem-based optimizer opposition-based learning (AEO-OBL) technique to optimal integration of renewable energy sources (RES) based distributed generation (DG) units, namely wind turbine (WT), photovoltaic (PV) and energy storage system (ESS) in the 33-bus distribution network (DN). This study is designed to minimize the total costs associated with ESS, PV, and WT-based DG units, installation, operation, maintenance costs, energy loss cost, cost of purchasing energy from the grid and emission cost taking into account uncertainty in generation of power, and variable load demands. According to the simulation results, it has been demonstrated that the total costs associated with the operation of the integrated system can be significantly reduced by optimally connecting DG units and ESS. Furthermore, the proposed algorithm has been demonstrated to be more effective in solving the optimization problem compared to other techniques, such as artificial ecosystem-based optimization (AEO), moth-flame optimization (MFO), and particle swarm optimization (PSO). According to the results of the test, AEO-OBL proved to be more efficient than other techniques when compared with other techniques.

articleTitle: Developing EDTL IDE Kernel with Xtext Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This process of creating an IDE core for the event-driven temporal requirements specification language called EDTL is outlined in the paper. Developed at the Institute of Automation and Electrometry SB RAS, EDTL is used for specifying requirements for reactive software. Such programs control cyber-physical systems, embedded systems, and PLC systems built using IEC 61131-3 or poST languages. Most of these safety critical systems are subject to mandatory verification. At the same time, as practice shows, failures in the operation of such systems in most cases are caused by errors in the specification of requirements. Therefore, the issue of requirements specification and the issue of requirements specification language are extremely important for the safety of the reactive system being developed. The advantages of EDTL include the relative simplicity of the language, the ability to specify requirements in terms of events and time intervals, independence from verification systems, and the presence of strict formal semantics that can be expressed using linear temporal logic. These advantages make EDTL a very promising requirements specification tool. The EDTL IDE comprises a language-oriented editor equipped with syntax and semantic analysis capabilities, an abstract syntax tree generator, and a library facilitating interaction with the generated abstract syntax tree. The research, the results of which are presented in the paper, is aimed at creating and EDTL IDE. The paper provides the motivation for the research, development requirements, IDE architecture, and the process of creating an IDE using the Eclipse toolchain. Finally, the article discusses the possibility of creating a web version of the EDTL IDE based on the results obtained and using Theia IDE.

articleTitle: Biofeedback in Rehabilitation (Modern Review)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE XVI International Scientific and Technical Conference Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents a review of current biofeedback-based neurorehabilitation tools. We examined 67 publications regarding biofeedback. A solitary biological signal is utilized as a means of providing feedback: electroencephalogram (EEG), electrocardiogram (ECG), skin electrical activity (EDA), vibroacoustic signals (pneumotachymetry, pulsometry, electromyogram (EMG). Each modification of biocontrol possesses distinct characteristics and is utilized in rehabilitation in relation to them. Presently, the most prevalent channel supported by evidence is the EEG channel. Nonetheless, even this channel fails to yield the desired outcomes that would indicate the unqualified success of biofeedback application. Considering this, we have introduced a novel biofeedback concept that has been the subject of discussion in the scientific community in recent years - multimodal biofeedback. The process of information fusion entails amalgamating dynamic and variable information from diverse sources to ascertain the condition of the controlled system, providing the clinician with a comprehensive understanding. We are of the belief that biofeedback technology is on the verge of swift advancement and integration in the field of rehabilitation medicine in the foreseeable future.
